】强大的AI自动研发团队]Awesome AI Auto-Research Team

用于汽车研究的人工智能：路线图和用户指南AI for Auto-Research: Roadmap & User Guide

Lingdong Kong∗    Xian Sun∗    Wei Chow∗    Linfeng Li    Kevin Qinghong Lin    Xuan Billy Zhang    Song Wang    Rong Li    Qing Wu    Wei Gao    Yingshuo Wang    Shaoyuan Xie    Jiachen Liu    Leigang Qu    Shijie Li    Lai Xing Ng    Benoit R. Cottereau    Ziwei Liu    Tat-Seng Chua    Wei Tsang Ooi [
摘要Abstract

人工智能辅助研究正在跨越一个门槛：全自动系统现在可以以低至 15 美元的价格生成研究论文，而长视野代理可以以最少的人工输入执行实验、起草手稿和模拟评论。然而，这种生产力前沿暴露了更深层次的诚信问题：在科学压力下，即使是前沿法学硕士仍然会捏造结果，错过隐藏的错误，并且无法可靠地判断新颖性。通过研究截至 2026 年 4 月的发展情况，我们对整个行业的人工智能进行了端到端分析AI-assisted research is crossing a threshold: fully automated systems can now generate research papers for as little as $15, while long-horizon agents can execute experiments, draft manuscripts, and simulate critique with minimal human input. Yet this productivity frontier exposes a deeper integrity problem: under scientific pressure, even frontier LLMs still fabricate results, miss hidden errors, and fail to judge novelty reliably. Studying developments through April 2026, we present an end-to-end analysis of AI across the完成complete研究生命周期分为四个认识论阶段：research lifecycle, organized into four epistemological phases:1创造Creation（想法产生、文献综述、编码和实验、表格和图形），(idea generation, literature review, coding & experiments, tables & figures),2写作Writing（论文写作），(paper writing),3验证Validation（同行评审、反驳和修订），以及(peer review, rebuttal & revision), and4传播Dissemination（海报、幻灯片、视频、社交媒体、项目页面和互动代理）。我们在可靠的协助和不可靠的自主之间确定了一个清晰的、依赖于阶段的界限：人工智能擅长结构化、基于检索和工具介导的任务，但在真正新颖的想法、研究级实验和科学判断方面仍然脆弱。产生的想法在实施后往往会退化，研究代码远远落后于模式匹配基准，并且端到端自治系统尚未始终达到主要场所的验收标准。我们进一步表明，更高的自动化程度可以掩盖而不是消除故障模式，从而使人工管理的协作成为最可靠的部署范例。最后，我们提供结构化分类法、基准套件和工具清单、跨阶段设计原则以及面向从业者的手册，并在我们的项目页面上维护资源。(posters, slides, videos, social media, project pages, and interactive agents). We identify a sharp, stage-dependent boundary between reliable assistance and unreliable autonomy: AI excels at structured, retrieval-grounded, and tool-mediated tasks, but remains fragile for genuinely novel ideas, research-level experiments, and scientific judgment. Generated ideas often degrade after implementation, research code lags far behind pattern-matching benchmarks, and end-to-end autonomous systems have not yet consistently reached major-venue acceptance standards. We further show that greater automation can obscure rather than eliminate failure modes, making human-governed collaboration the most credible deployment paradigm. Finally, we provide a structured taxonomy, benchmark suite, and tool inventory, cross-stage design principles, and a practitioner-oriented playbook, with resources maintained at our project page.

1 简介Introduction

人工智能辅助研究正在跨越一个门槛。大型语言模型（LLM）及其代理扩展不再局限于本地编写或编码支持；他们开始在整个研究生命周期中运作。最近的系统说明了这种转变的规模：AI 科学家以每篇论文大约 15 美元的价格生成了完整的研究论文AI-assisted research is crossing a threshold. Large language models (LLMs) and their agentic extensions are no longer limited to local writing or coding support; they are beginning to operate across the research lifecycle itself. Recent systems illustrate the scale of this shift: The AI Scientist generated complete research papers at roughly $15 per paper[122]; FARS 连续运行了; FARS ran continuously for228228小时，消耗hours, consumed11.411.4十亿代币，并产生billion tokens, and produced100100论文，平均每一篇papers, averaging one every2.32.3小时hours[14]; ARIS 报告了一个通宵运行的工作流程; and ARIS reports an overnight workflow that ran20+20+GPU 实验，修剪不受支持的声明，并提高草稿分数GPU experiments, pruned unsupported claims, and improved a draft score from5.05.0 to 7.57.5通过迭代审查和修改through iterative review and revision[232]。这些系统提出了一种新的范式：人工智能正在从协助个人研究任务转向编排多阶段工作流程，产生想法、搜索文献、执行实验、起草手稿、模拟批评和准备传播材料。. These systems suggest a new paradigm: AI is moving from assisting individual research tasks to orchestrating multi-stage workflows that generate ideas, search literature, execute experiments, draft manuscripts, simulate critique, and prepare dissemination materials.

这种快速进展也暴露了该领域的决定性紧张。人工智能系统越来越有能力产生类似研究的工件，但在验证这些工件是否新颖、忠实、可执行和具有科学意义方面仍然远不那么可靠。产生的想法可能看起来很有希望，但实施后却会减弱This rapid progress also exposes the defining tension of the field. AI systems are increasingly capable of producing research-like artifacts, yet remain far less reliable at verifying whether those artifacts are novel, faithful, executable, and scientifically meaningful. Generated ideas can appear promising but weaken after implementation[184];生成的代码可以在实现错误的算法时运行; generated code can run while implementing the wrong algorithm[71];流畅的手稿可以掩盖没有根据的主张；自动评论可能连贯但宽松或容易受到操纵; fluent manuscripts can conceal unsupported claims; automated reviews can be coherent yet lenient or vulnerable to manipulation[266];反驳可以承诺稍后不会实现的修改; rebuttals can promise revisions that are not later fulfilled[21];传播材料可以简化证据之外的结果。因此，核心挑战不再是人工智能能否产生; and dissemination materials can simplify results beyond the evidence. The core challenge is therefore no longer whether AI can produce the形式forms的研究，但它是否可以保留of research, but whether it can preserve the物质substance研究的核心：证据、判断、出处和责任。of research: evidence, judgment, provenance, and accountability.

生命周期视图对于理解这一挑战至关重要。研究不是独立任务的集合：想法变成实验，实验变成主张，主张变成手稿，评论变成修订，论文变成面向公众的摘要。早期引入的错误可能会在下游被放大，特别是当人工智能系统在没有保留证据或出处的情况下生成合理的输出时。尽管研究代理、写作助手、科学编码工具、自动审稿人、反驳系统和 Paper2X 应用程序迅速兴起，但该领域仍然缺乏对整个学术生命周期的人工智能自动研究的统一分析。如果没有这样的观点，就很难确定人工智能在哪里可靠地提供帮助，在哪里系统性地失败，以及哪些部署模式在科学上是可信的。A lifecycle view is essential for understanding this challenge. Research is not a collection of independent tasks: ideas become experiments, experiments become claims, claims become manuscripts, reviews become revisions, and papers become public-facing summaries. Errors introduced early can be amplified downstream, especially when AI systems generate plausible outputs without preserving evidence or provenance. Despite the rapid emergence of research agents, writing assistants, scientific coding tools, automated reviewers, rebuttal systems, and Paper2X applications, the field still lacks a unified analysis of AI auto-research across the complete academic lifecycle. Without such a view, it is difficult to determine where AI reliably helps, where it fails systematically, and which deployment modes are scientifically credible.

通过调查截至 2026 年 4 月的发展情况，我们首次对整个学术研究生命周期中的人工智能自动研究进行端到端分析。我们将该领域分为四个认识论阶段和八个阶段：Surveying developments through April 2026, we present the first end-to-end analysis of AI auto-research across the complete academic research lifecycle. We organize the field into four epistemological phases and eight stages:1创造Creation，涵盖创意生成、文献综述、编码和实验以及表格和图形；, covering idea generation, literature review, coding & experiments, and tables & figures;2写作Writing，涵盖论文写作；, covering paper writing;3验证Validation，涵盖同行评审和反驳与修改；和, covering peer review and rebuttal & revision; and4传播Dissemination，涵盖海报、幻灯片、视频、社交媒体、项目页面和交互式纸质代理。这种结构遵循研究的时间顺序，同时明确每个阶段引入的独特的人工智能功能、风险和验证要求。, covering posters, slides, videos, social media, project pages, and interactive paper agents. This structure follows the temporal sequence of research while making explicit the distinct AI capabilities, risks, and verification requirements introduced by each phase.

我们的分析得出了五个主要发现。首先，当任务是结构化的、有根据的和外部可检查的时，人工智能的能力最强，但对于需要新颖性、隐性领域知识、长期推理或科学判断的开放式研究任务来说，人工智能的能力急剧下降。其次，工件生成的速度始终超过验证的速度：在各个阶段，人工智能产生合理输出的速度通常快于证明它们是正确的、忠实的或有意义的。第三，最可靠的部署模式是人为协作，而不是完全自主：人工智能可以减少检索、起草、编码、可视化、审稿支持和传播中的机械摩擦，但研究人员必须保留判断、解释、实验设计、论证和问责的责任。第四，有效的系统越来越依赖于结合探索、基于工具的执行和验证的分层架构，这表明编排、来源和反馈设计与模型规模一样重要。第五，人工智能在研究中的使用正在成为一个治理问题，而不是一个检测问题：随着人工智能援助成为常规，关键问题是披露、归属、责任以及是否保持科学完整性。Our analysis yields five central findings. First, AI capability is strongest when tasks are structured, grounded, and externally checkable, but drops sharply for open-ended research tasks requiring novelty, implicit domain knowledge, long-horizon reasoning, or scientific judgment. Second, artifact generation consistently outpaces verification: across stages, AI can often produce plausible outputs faster than it can prove that they are correct, faithful, or meaningful. Third, the most reliable deployment mode is human-governed collaboration rather than full autonomy: AI can reduce mechanical friction in retrieval, drafting, coding, visualization, review support, and dissemination, but researchers must retain responsibility for judgment, interpretation, experimental design, argumentation, and accountability. Fourth, effective systems increasingly rely on layered architectures that combine exploration, tool-based execution, and verification, suggesting that orchestration, provenance, and feedback design are as important as model scale. Fifth, AI use in research is becoming a governance problem rather than a detection problem: as AI assistance becomes routine, the key questions are disclosure, attribution, responsibility, and whether scientific integrity is preserved.

这项工作对人工智能自动研究这一新兴领域做出了三点贡献：This work makes three contributions to the emerging field of AI auto-research:

  • •

    我们提供了跨越四个阶段和八个阶段的人工智能自动研究的统一分类，涵盖写作和编码等成熟领域，以及反驳、科学可视化和研究传播等尚未开发的领域。We provide a unified taxonomy of AI auto-research across four phases and eight stages, covering both mature areas such as writing and coding, and underexplored areas such as rebuttal, scientific visualization, and research dissemination.

  • •

    我们综合了整个生命周期的工具、基准和方法系列，展示了系统如何从基于提示的辅助演变为检索增强、代理、微调和混合工作流程。We synthesize tools, benchmarks, and methodological families across the lifecycle, showing how systems have evolved from prompt-based assistance to retrieval-augmented, agentic, fine-tuned, and hybrid workflows.

  • •

    我们确定跨领域的能力边界和开放的挑战，包括阶段边界的忠实性、科学判断、可重复性、引用来源、治理、跨领域泛化和认知所有权。We identify cross-cutting capability boundaries and open challenges, including phase-boundary faithfulness, scientific judgment, reproducibility, citation provenance, governance, cross-domain generalization, and cognitive ownership.

2 预赛Preliminaries

随着人工智能辅助研究工具从孤立的单阶段（例如写作或编码辅助）扩展到多阶段助手，该领域变得越来越难以使用单一词汇进行比较。现有系统不仅在技术设计上有所不同，而且在它们所针对的研究阶段、所承担的自主程度以及所引入的科学风险的形式方面也有所不同。As AI-assisted research tools expand from isolated single stages (such as writing or coding aids) into multi-stage assistants, the field has become increasingly difficult to compare using a single vocabulary. Existing systems differ not only in their technical designs, but also in the research stages they target, the degree of autonomy they assume, and the forms of scientific risk they introduce.

为了支持统一分析，我们首先建立To support a unified analysis, we first establish四个基本要素four foundational elements：（i）组织本次调查的高水平学术研究生命周期框架（: (i) the high-level academic research lifecycle framework that organizes this survey (section˜2.1), (ii) 每个阶段重复出现的方法系列 (), (ii) the methodological families that recur across each stage (section˜2.2），（iii）我们文献收集的范围和方法（), (iii) the scope and methodology of our literature collection (section˜2.3），以及（iv）关键进展的简要时间表（), and (iv) a brief timeline of key developments (section˜2.4).

2.1 研究生命周期Research Lifecycle

我们将研究生命周期定义为We define the research lifecycle as八个相互关联的阶段eight interconnected stages，组织成, organized into四个阶段four phases。每个阶段都对在科学知识的生产、验证和传播中发挥共同功能的阶段进行分组。. Each phase groups stages that serve a shared function in the production, validation, and communication of scientific knowledge.

第一阶段：创造。Phase 1: Creation.这一阶段涵盖了研究贡献实质产生的阶段，包括假设形成、证据收集、实验和科学可视化。This phase covers the stages through which a research contribution is materially produced, including hypothesis formation, evidence gathering, experimentation, and scientific visualization.

第二阶段：写作。Phase 2: Writing.此阶段组织输出This phase organizes the outputs of创造Creation转化为正式的学术手稿，以供交流和外部审查。into a formal scholarly manuscript for communication and external scrutiny.

第三阶段：验证。Phase 3: Validation.这一阶段涵盖了研究界审查、批评和迭代完善手稿的阶段。This phase covers the stages through which the research community scrutinizes, critiques, and iteratively refines a manuscript.

第四阶段：传播。Phase 4: Dissemination.此阶段将手稿及其支持材料转换为更广泛的研究和公众受众可以访问的格式。This phase converts the manuscript and its supporting materials into formats accessible to broader research and public audiences.

尽管按时间顺序呈现，但生命周期并不是严格线性的。第三阶段审稿人的批评（Although presented in temporal order, the lifecycle is not strictly linear. Reviewer critiques in Phase 3 (验证Validation）可能需要返回到第一阶段（) may require returning to Phase 1 (创造Creation）进行额外实验，同时在第 4 阶段传播输出（) for additional experiments, while dissemination outputs in Phase 4 (传播Dissemination）可能会暴露出歧义或错误，从而触发第 2 阶段的修订（) may expose ambiguities or errors that trigger revisions in Phase 2 (写作Writing）。这些反馈循环是研究实践的核心，对于人工智能辅助的工作流程尤其重要，如果不明确检查，错误可能会跨阶段传播。). These feedback loops are central to research practice and are especially important for AI-assisted workflows, where errors can propagate across stages if not explicitly checked.

这四个阶段的分组反映了研究的功能结构。证据和文物产生于This four-phase grouping reflects the functional structure of research. Evidence and artifacts are produced in 创造Creation，整理成一份手稿, organized into a manuscript in 写作Writing, 外部审查, externally scrutinized in 验证Validation，并传达给更广泛的受众, and communicated to broader audiences in 传播Dissemination.

我们分开We separate写作Writing来自from创造Creation因为手稿构建不仅仅是一个格式化步骤：它是一个修辞和证据组织过程，需要不同于用于生成代码、实验或图表的人工智能功能。我们将同行评审和反驳分组为because manuscript construction is not merely a formatting step: it is a rhetorical and evidential organization process that requires different AI capabilities from those used to produce code, experiments, or figures. We group Peer Review and Rebuttal under验证Validation因为它们共同构成了面向社区的机制，通过该机制对主张提出质疑、辩护和修改。最后，我们对待because together they form the community-facing mechanism through which claims are challenged, defended, and revised. Finally, we treat传播Dissemination作为一个完整的阶段，因为海报、幻灯片、视频、项目页面和社交媒体摘要是越来越重要的知识工件，具有自己的保真度和信任要求。as a full phase because posters, slides, videos, project pages, and social media summaries are increasingly important knowledge artifacts with their own fidelity and trust requirements.

2.2 方法论家族Methodological Families

在整个研究生命周期中，人工智能辅助研究系统重复使用一小组方法模式。我们将它们分为五个大家族：Across the research lifecycle, AI-assisted research systems reuse a small set of methodological patterns. We group them into five broad families:1及时工程prompt engineering, 2检索增强生成（RAG）retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), 3免训练代理方法training-free agentic methods, 4基于训练的方法training-based methods, 和, and5混合方法hybrid approaches。这些家族并不相互排斥或严格按时间顺序排列；相反，它们描述了当前系统如何引发、基础、专业化和协调法学硕士行为。许多实用系统将其中的几个结合起来，例如使用分解提示、用于基础的 RAG、用于执行的工具以及用于评分或排名的训练模块。. These families are not mutually exclusive or strictly chronological; rather, they describe how current systems elicit, ground, specialize, and orchestrate LLM behavior. Many practical systems combine several of them, for example using prompts for decomposition, RAG for grounding, tools for execution, and trained modules for scoring or ranking.

及时工程Prompt engineering提供最简单的界面，使通用法学硕士适应研究任务provides the simplest interface for adapting general-purpose LLMs to research tasks[217, 238]。它包括直接提示、思维链推理、角色分配、结构化模板、基于标题的说明和输出约束。由于它不需要额外的培训，因此仍然广泛用于头脑风暴、编辑、起草评论、反驳大纲和社交媒体生成等轻量级任务，但它对提示措辞很敏感，通常缺乏持久的基础。. It includes direct prompting, chain-of-thought reasoning, role assignment, structured templates, rubric-based instructions, and output constraints. Because it requires no additional training, it remains widely used for lightweight tasks such as brainstorming, editing, review drafting, rebuttal outlining, and social media generation, but it is sensitive to prompt wording and usually lacks persistent grounding.

检索增强生成 (RAG)Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)外部来源中的模型输出，包括论文语料库、引文图、代码存储库、基准记录和实验日志grounds model outputs in external sources, including paper corpora, citation graphs, code repositories, benchmark records, and experimental logs[98]。这对于文献综述、引文支持、证据检查、反驳生成以及需要来源归属的阶段尤其重要。 RAG 通过在推理时将模型暴露给证据来减少幻觉，但不能确保所选来源是正确的、版本一致的或如实地表示的。. It is especially important for literature review, citation support, evidence checking, rebuttal generation, and stages where source attribution is required. RAG reduces hallucination by exposing models to evidence at inference time, but does not ensure that selected sources are correct, version-consistent, or faithfully represented.

免训练代理方法Training-free agentic methods通过规划、工具使用、记忆、自我反思和迭代执行来扩展法学硕士，无需更新模型参数即可实现多步骤工作流程extend LLMs with planning, tool use, memory, self-reflection, and iterative execution, enabling multi-step workflows without updating model parameters[238, 169, 182]。这些方法对于深度文献探索、代码调试、实验编排、评审-响应规划和 Paper2X 工作流程至关重要。它们的优势在于编排，而它们的主要风险是检索、工具使用或自我批评失败时的错误传播。. These methods are central to deep literature exploration, code debugging, experiment orchestration, review-response planning, and Paper2X workflows. Their strength lies in orchestration, while their main risk is error propagation when retrieval, tool use, or self-critique fails.

基于训练的方法Training-based methods针对特定阶段的分布专门化模型，例如同行评审、科学手稿、代码存储库、引用上下文、反驳轨迹或基准轨迹specialize models for stage-specific distributions, such as peer reviews, scientific manuscripts, code repositories, citation contexts, rebuttal traces, or benchmark trajectories[144, 213]。它们包括监督微调、指令调整、偏好优化、强化学习和特定领域的适应。它们可以提高一致性、格式一致性、领域词汇和特定于任务的判断，但在很大程度上依赖于数据质量，并且可能会过度适应狭窄的基准或场地分布。. They include supervised fine-tuning, instruction tuning, preference optimization, reinforcement learning, and domain-specific adaptation. They can improve consistency, format adherence, domain vocabulary, and task-specific judgment, but depend heavily on data quality and may overfit to narrow benchmark or venue distributions.

混合方法Hybrid approaches将多个系列组合到集成研究系统中，例如通过将 RAG 与代理规划相结合、微调特定领域的子模块或将基于提示的控制器嵌入到更大的工作流程中combine multiple families into integrated research systems, for example by coupling RAG with agentic planning, fine-tuning domain-specific submodules, or embedding prompt-based controllers inside larger workflows[122, 94, 178, 9]。混合系统越来越占主导地位，因为研究工作流程需要生成和基础、自主和验证，以及具有特定阶段专业化的灵活推理。. Hybrid systems are increasingly dominant because research workflows require generation and grounding, autonomy and verification, and flexible reasoning with stage-specific specialization.

2.3 范围和文献收集Scope & Literature Collection

本次调查重点关注支持人工智能的工具、方法和基准This survey focuses on AI tools, methods, and benchmarks that support以人为本的学术研究human-driven academic research，重点是计算机科学和机器学习。我们涵盖了 2023 年至 2026 年初期间发表或公开发布的工作，同时在定义重复技术范式时也引用了早期的基础方法。当跨学科系统表现出与研究生命周期相关的能力时，例如自主实验、文献综合、科学编码或基于证据的写作，就被包括在内。我们排除与研究工作流程没有明确关联的通用法学硕士功能，以及技术或评估信息不足的封闭系统。, with an emphasis on computer science and machine learning. We cover work published or publicly released between 2023 and early 2026, while also referencing earlier foundational methods when they define recurring technical paradigms. Cross-disciplinary systems are included when they demonstrate capabilities relevant to the research lifecycle, such as autonomous experimentation, literature synthesis, scientific coding, or evidence-grounded writing. We exclude general-purpose LLM capabilities that are not explicitly connected to research workflows, as well as closed systems for which insufficient technical or evaluative information is available.

2.4 开发时间表Development Timeline

人工智能辅助研究的发展可以理解为从The development of AI-assisted research can be understood as a shift from阶段性协助stage-specific assistance朝向toward多阶段研究自动化multi-stage research automation。 2024 年之前，大多数系统都针对孤立的研究任务，例如文献检索、科学问答、代码生成或特定领域的实验规划。早期的示威活动，包括Coscientist. Before 2024, most systems targeted isolated research tasks, such as literature search, scientific question answering, code generation, or domain-specific experiment planning. Early demonstrations, including Coscientist[15]，表明基于 LLM 的代理可以在有限的实验室环境中规划和执行科学工作流程，而领域基础模型（例如 AlphaFold 3）, showed that LLM-based agents could plan and execute scientific workflows in constrained laboratory settings, while domain foundation models such as AlphaFold 3[1]展示了人工智能系统在改变专业科学发现方面的更广泛潜力。illustrated the broader potential of AI systems to transform specialized scientific discovery.

2024 年，该领域开始从孤立的工具转向端到端的研究代理。人工智能科学家In 2024, the field began moving from isolated tools toward end-to-end research agents. The AI Scientist[122]提供了涵盖创意生成、实验执行、论文写作和评论式评估的自动化流程的早期演示。大约在同一时期，通用编码代理、检索增强文献系统和科学推理基准迅速成熟，使得更系统地评估研究生命周期的各个组成部分成为可能。这一转变标志着重点的重要变化：人工智能系统不再仅仅被视为本地任务的助手，而是越来越多地被视为多步骤研究工作流程的协调者。provided an early demonstration of an automated pipeline spanning idea generation, experiment execution, paper writing, and review-style evaluation. Around the same period, general coding agents, retrieval-augmented literature systems, and scientific reasoning benchmarks matured rapidly, making it possible to evaluate individual components of the research lifecycle more systematically. This transition marked an important change in emphasis: AI systems were no longer viewed only as assistants for local tasks, but increasingly as orchestrators of multi-step research workflows.

到2025年和2026年初，该领域进入快速专业化和标杆化阶段。几乎每个生命周期阶段都出现了专用系统，包括文献综合、论文到代码的翻译、自主实验编排、手稿撰写、同行评审、反驳支持、图形生成和研究传播。例如，开放学者By 2025 and early 2026, the field entered a stage of rapid specialization and benchmarking. Dedicated systems emerged for nearly every lifecycle stage, including literature synthesis, paper-to-code translation, autonomous experiment orchestration, manuscript writing, peer review, rebuttal support, figure generation, and research dissemination. For example, OpenScholar[9]高级检索增强科学综合，AI Scientist v2advanced retrieval-augmented scientific synthesis, AI Scientist v2[228]探索更强大的端到端自动化研究形式和 FARSexplored stronger forms of end-to-end automated research, and FARS[14]展示了大规模自主纸张生成。与此同时，以前未充分探索的阶段开始受到专门关注，包括反驳写作（demonstrated large-scale autonomous paper generation. At the same time, previously underexplored stages began receiving dedicated attention, including rebuttal writing (例如e.g., 反驳代理, RebuttalAgent[63]）和科学可视化（) and scientific visualization (例如e.g.、自动图形编辑, AutoFigure-Edit[114]).

这些发展表明，该领域不再仅仅受到模型能力的瓶颈，还受到整个研究生命周期的编排、评估、可靠性和治理的瓶颈。These developments suggest that the field is no longer bottlenecked by model capability alone, but also by orchestration, evaluation, reliability, and governance across the full research lifecycle.

3 第一阶段：创造Phase 1: Creation

这个阶段涵盖了研究贡献实质上产生的阶段：产生一个想法（This phase covers the stages through which a research contribution is materially produced: generating an idea (），将其置于之前的工作中（), situating it within prior work (），产生经验或分析证据（), producing empirical or analytical evidence (），并构建方法和结果的视觉表示（), and constructing visual representations of methods and results (）。这些阶段共同解决了两个基本问题：). Together, these stages address two foundational questions:贡献是什么？有什么证据支持它？what is the contribution, and what evidence supports it?

这四个阶段中，Among the four phases,创造Creation目前拥有最丰富的工具生态系统和最广泛的基准覆盖范围，但其成熟度仍然参差不齐。currently has the richest tool ecosystem and broadest benchmark coverage, but its maturity remains uneven. (创意产生Idea Generation）吸引了广泛的工具，但仍存在构思与执行之间的差距，看似新颖的想法在实施后往往会减弱。) has attracted extensive tooling, yet suffers from an ideation–execution gap in which seemingly novel ideas often weaken after implementation. (文献综述Literature Review）通过检索增强和代理合成正在迅速改进，但引用保真度、覆盖完整性和多论文关系推理仍然很困难。) is rapidly improving through retrieval-augmented and agentic synthesis, but citation fidelity, coverage completeness, and multi-paper relational reasoning remain difficult. (编码和实验Coding and Experiments）在代码生成、论文到代码翻译和自主实验编排方面取得了进展，但在真正新颖的研究代码上性能仍然急剧下降。) has progressed through code generation, paper-to-code translation, and autonomous experiment orchestration, but performance still drops sharply on genuinely novel research code. (表格和数字Tables and Figures尽管它在日常研究实践中很重要，但仍然相对不发达。下面我们按顺序讨论这四个阶段。) remains comparatively underdeveloped despite its importance in daily research practice. We discuss these four stages in order below.

3.1 创意产生Idea Generation

想法生成是研究生命周期的入口点，在此提出并完善候选假设、研究问题和实验方向。现有的方法包括直接法学硕士促进、外部接地生成、多主体协作以及对新颖性、可行性、多样性和下游影响的专门评估。在这些方向上，核心挑战是法学硕士可以产生看似新颖且动机良好的想法，但往往很难产生在执行后仍然可行、独特和有影响力的想法。Idea generation is the entry point of the research lifecycle, where candidate hypotheses, research questions, and experimental directions are proposed and refined. Existing approaches range from direct LLM prompting to externally grounded generation, multi-agent collaboration, and dedicated evaluation of novelty, feasibility, diversity, and downstream impact. Across these directions, the central challenge is that LLMs can produce ideas that appear novel and well-motivated, yet often struggle to generate ideas that remain feasible, distinctive, and impactful after execution.

This result demonstrates the surface-level generative capacity of LLMs, but it also raises a central question for this stage: whether apparent novelty corresponds to executable and impactful research.
