3.1.2 外部信号驱动生成External Signal-Driven Generation

直接的法学硕士生成受到模型参数知识及其产生看似合理但基础薄弱的想法的倾向的限制。外部信号驱动的方法通过将构思锚定在结构化知识、检索到的文献或时间研究趋势中来解决这一局限性。三种信号源尤其常见，每种信号源都从不同的角度出发：关系结构、文本证据和时间机会。Direct LLM generation is limited by the model’s parametric knowledge and by its tendency to produce plausible but weakly grounded ideas. External signal-driven methods address this limitation by anchoring ideation in structured knowledge, retrieved literature, or temporal research trends. Three signal sources are especially common, each grounding ideas from a different perspective: relational structure, textual evidence, and temporal opportunity.

知识图谱Knowledge graphs为假设形成提供关系结构。科学特工provide relational structure for hypothesis formation. SciAgents[49]对科学知识图进行多主体推理，而 MOOSE-Chemperforms multi-agent reasoning over scientific knowledge graphs, while MOOSE-Chem[237]将化学假设生成分解为灵感检索、假设组成和排名，从decomposes chemistry hypothesis generation into inspiration retrieval, hypothesis composition, and ranking, rediscovering hypotheses from5151高影响力的论文。 MOOSE-Chem2high-impact papers. MOOSE-Chem2[236]将这个方向扩展到细粒度的、实验上可行的假设。extends this direction toward fine-grained, experimentally actionable hypotheses.论文检索Paper retrieval将思想扎根于非结构化文献中。科学PIPgrounds ideas in unstructured literature. SciPIP[211]提出与检索到的论文相关的想法，以及 IdeaSynthproposes ideas anchored to retrieved papers, and IdeaSynth[152]将想法方面表示为交互式画布上的节点，以进行基于文献的改进；在一项用户研究中represents idea facets as nodes on an interactive canvas for literature-grounded refinement; in a user study with2020参与者，IdeaSynth 鼓励用户探索比仅 LLM 基线更多的替代方案。participants, IdeaSynth encouraged users to explore more alternatives than LLM-only baselines.趋势分析Trend analysis针对研究机会的时间维度。诺瓦targets the temporal dimension of research opportunity. Nova[69]使用迭代规划和搜索来确定具有改进多样性的新兴研究方向。总之，这些方法表明，外部接地不仅仅是一个辅助特征，而且是将产生的想法与研究前沿联系起来的关键机制。uses iterative planning and search to identify emerging research directions with improved diversity. Together, these methods suggest that external grounding is not merely an auxiliary feature, but a key mechanism for connecting generated ideas to the research frontier.

3.1.3 多Agent协同生成Multi-Agent Collaborative Generation

多智能体构思系统试图通过模拟研究社区互动的各个方面（例如角色专业化、批评、修订和辩论）来提高创意质量。虚拟科学Multi-agent ideation systems attempt to improve idea quality by simulating aspects of research-community interaction, such as role specialization, critique, revision, and debate. VirSci[193]构建了一个虚拟科学社区，其中多个 LLM 代理参与结构化讨论，报告比单代理 AI 科学家基线更高的新颖性分数（constructs a virtual scientific community in which multiple LLM agents participate in structured discussions, reporting higher novelty scores than a single-agent AI Scientist baseline (5.245.24与vs.4.944.94）。其分析表明，代理多样性和讨论结构很重要，最好的配置是使用). Its analysis suggests that agent diversity and discussion structure matter, with the best configuration using88会员超过members over55轮与rounds with50%50\%多样性。diversity.

然而，多智能体扩展并不总是有益的。 SIGDIAL 2025 年研究However, multi-agent scaling is not uniformly beneficial. A SIGDIAL 2025 study[206]发现三轮批评-修订通常就足够了，而额外的轮次会产生收益递减。其他系统探索更丰富的协作机制，超出了单独讨论的范围：Gufinds that three critique–revision rounds are often sufficient, while additional rounds produce diminishing returns. Other systems explore richer collaboration mechanisms beyond discussion alone: Gu等人。et al. [57]学习study组合创造力combinatorial creativity通过跨领域构想和深度构想by composing ideas across domains, and Deep Ideation[258]设计通过结构化图探索来导航科学概念网络的代理。designs agents that navigate scientific concept networks through structured graph exploration.

然而，最近的证据也指出了更深层次的局限性：“人工蜂巢”研究Yet recent evidence also points to a deeper limitation: the “Artificial Hivemind” study[79]报道称，法学硕士产生的想法往往聚集在想法空间的狭窄区域，这表明多样性崩溃可能是当前模型的结构特性，而不是简单地通过添加更多代理来解决的问题。reports that LLM-generated ideas tend to cluster in narrow regions of the idea space, suggesting that diversity collapse may be a structural property of current models rather than a problem solved simply by adding more agents.

3.1.4 评估：新颖性和可行性Assessment: Novelty and Feasibility

评估所产生的想法很困难，因为强大的研究想法必须同时满足多个标准：新颖性、可行性、清晰度、重要性和最终影响。早期的基准测试量化了这一领域的部分内容，但核心问题是，一个想法在实施、测试并对照之前的工作进行定位后是否仍然有价值。Evaluating generated ideas is difficult because strong research ideas must satisfy multiple criteria simultaneously: novelty, feasibility, clarity, significance, and eventual impact. Early benchmarks quantify parts of this space, but the central question is whether an idea remains valuable after it is implemented, tested, and situated against prior work.

创意台IdeaBench[59]评估想法的产生evaluates idea generation against2,3742{,}374跨越八个研究领域的有影响力的论文，而 LiveIdeaBenchinfluential papers across eight research domains, while LiveIdeaBench[162]使用探索科学创造力probes scientific creativity using1,1801{,}180关键字提示跨越keyword prompts across2222域。两者都表明，通用基准不能很好地预测科学创造力，以推理为中心的模型通常表现更好。研究台domains. Both suggest that scientific creativity is not well predicted by general-purpose benchmarks, with reasoning-focused models often performing better. ResearchBench[120]通过基于灵感的任务分解和 AI Idea Bench 2025 扩展评估extends evaluation through inspiration-based task decomposition, and AI Idea Bench 2025[154]将评估范围调整为scales assessment to3,4953{,}495跨越两个评估轴的论文。papers across two evaluation axes.

这些基准测试中反复出现的一个模式是明显的新颖性和实际可行性之间的差距。 IdeaBench 报告称许多法学硕士得分高于A recurring pattern across these benchmarks is the gap between apparent novelty and practical feasibility. IdeaBench reports that many LLMs score above0.60.6新颖但低于on novelty but below0.50.5关于可行性on feasibility[59]，表明产生听起来合理的想法仍然比产生可以执行和验证的想法更容易。后见之明, indicating that generating plausible-sounding ideas remains easier than generating ideas that can be executed and validated. HindSight[78]通过引入时间分割、基于影响力的评估，加剧了这种担忧，表明法学硕士作为法官可能会高估听起来新颖的想法，而这些想法后来不会具体化为有影响力的工作。这一发现表明，当前的评估协议可能会奖励明显的新颖性，而不是真正的研究潜力，从而强化了基于执行和暂时稳健评估的需求。sharpens this concern by introducing a time-split, impact-based evaluation, showing that LLM-as-Judge can overvalue novel-sounding ideas that do not later materialize into impactful work. This finding suggests that current evaluation protocols may reward apparent novelty rather than genuine research potential, reinforcing the need for execution-grounded and temporally robust assessment.

3.1.5 调查结果和观察结果Findings and Observations

3.2 文献综述Literature Review

文献综述通过检索相关工作、综合证据并将现有发现组织成一个连贯的知识背景，将研究锚定在先验知识上。与创意生成相比，这一阶段更加接地气、可外部验证，是人工智能辅助研究中成熟最快的领域之一。现有系统已经从语义论文检索转向引文感知综合和长期深度研究代理。然而，两个限制仍然是核心：系统可以越来越好地检索和总结单篇论文，但仍然难以忠实引用、覆盖完整性和多论文关系推理。Literature review anchors research in prior knowledge by retrieving relevant work, synthesizing evidence, and organizing existing findings into a coherent intellectual context. Compared with idea generation, this stage is more grounded and externally verifiable, making it one of the fastest-maturing areas in AI-assisted research. Existing systems have moved from semantic paper retrieval to citation-aware synthesis and long-horizon deep research agents. Yet two limitations remain central: systems can retrieve and summarize individual papers increasingly well, but still struggle with faithful citation, coverage completeness, and multi-paper relational reasoning.

文献综述系统的全面清单提供于A comprehensive inventory of literature review systems is provided intable˜4（附录）。(Appendix).

3.2.1 文献检索Literature Retrieval

检索是人工智能辅助文献综述的基础：每一次下游综合都取决于系统是否能够从目前包含数千万条条目的科学语料库中检索出正确的论文。现有方法可以分为三种模式。Retrieval is the foundation of AI-assisted literature review: every downstream synthesis depends on whether the system can surface the right papers from scientific corpora that now contain tens of millions of entries. Existing methods can be grouped into three modes.语义检索Semantic retrieval形成基线，使用密集表示和基于 LLM 的查询理解来超越关键字匹配。法学硕士forms the baseline, using dense representations and LLM-based query understanding to move beyond keyword matching. LitLLM[2]将法学硕士与学术数据库集成以进行密集检索，而 PaperQA2integrates LLMs with academic databases for dense retrieval, while PaperQA2[189]通过引文验证扩展了这一方向，并报告了科学文献检索的强劲表现。extends this direction with citation verification and reports strong performance on scientific literature search.

引文图增强检索Citation-graph-augmented retrieval添加嵌入之外的结构信号。这些方法不是将论文视为孤立的文档，而是使用引用链接、论文关系和图形遍历来提高上下文覆盖率。开放研究员adds structural signals beyond embeddings. Instead of treating papers as isolated documents, these methods use citation links, paper relations, and graph traversal to improve contextual coverage. OpenResearcher[264]将 RAG 与图遍历相结合以加速文献探索。combines RAG with graph traversal for accelerated literature exploration.代理多步检索Agentic multi-step retrieval进一步将检索从一次性排序问题转变为迭代搜索过程。帕萨further shifts retrieval from a one-shot ranking problem to an iterative search process. PaSa[62]部署一个 LLM 代理，该代理发出后续查询并细化候选集，类似于人类研究人员探索不熟悉主题的方式。除了这些方法之外，还出现了专门的基准来审核检索质量：LitSearchdeploys an LLM agent that issues follow-up queries and refines candidate sets, approximating how human researchers probe an unfamiliar topic. Alongside these methods, dedicated benchmarks have emerged to audit retrieval quality: LitSearch[4]目标是检索精度，而 CiteMEtargets retrieval precision, while CiteME[151]注重引文保真度。总之，这些努力表明，查找相关论文变得越来越容易，但确保检索到的论文得到忠实使用仍然很困难。focuses on citation fidelity. Together, these efforts show that finding relevant papers is becoming easier, but ensuring that retrieved papers are used faithfully remains difficult.

3.2.2 调查和相关工作生成Survey and Related Work Generation

综合将检索到的论文转化为结构化叙述。这标志着从优化论文排名和覆盖范围的检索导向系统向必须确定主题、比较方法、揭露矛盾和阐明研究差距的生成导向系统的转变。该子领域通过几种日益结构化的设计得到了发展。Synthesis transforms retrieved papers into structured narratives. This marks a shift from retrieval-oriented systems, which optimize paper ranking and coverage, to generation-oriented systems, which must identify themes, compare methods, expose contradictions, and articulate research gaps. The subfield has developed through several increasingly structured designs.

单程系统Single-pass systems确立了自动化调查起草的可行性。自动测量established the feasibility of automated survey drafting. AutoSurvey[214]证明 LLM 可以生成端到端质量合理的调查，而 SurveyXdemonstrated that LLMs can generate surveys of reasonable quality end-to-end, while SurveyX[110]提高了内容质量并在选定的维度上接近人类专家的表现。improved content quality and approached human-expert performance on selected dimensions.结构感知系统Structure-aware systems然后将大纲规划从格式化步骤提升为核心综合工件。风暴then elevated outline planning from a formatting step to a core synthesis artifact. STORM[178]引入多视角提问来构建全面的主题大纲，以及SurveyForgeintroduces multi-perspective question-asking to build comprehensive topic outlines, and SurveyForge[229]从人工编写的调查中学习大纲启发法以及记忆驱动的内容生成，在大纲质量方面优于 AutoSurvey。learns outline heuristics from human-written surveys together with memory-driven content generation, outperforming AutoSurvey on outline quality.

多智能体分解Multi-agent decomposition将检索、验证、组织和叙述性写作分成专门的子任务。利拉separates retrieval, verification, organization, and narrative writing into specialized subtasks. LiRA[51]和代理自动测量and Agentic AutoSurvey[119]为不同的角色雇用专门的代理，而 IterSurveyemploy dedicated agents for different roles, while IterSurvey[250]将轮廓生成视为具有稳定性检查的迭代规划问题。互动调查treats outline generation as an iterative planning problem with stability checks. InteractiveSurvey[219]进一步引入了用户定制，允许研究人员通过交互式界面细化参考分类和大纲结构。further introduces user customization, allowing researchers to refine reference categorization and outline structure through an interactive interface.

引文和编辑感知系统Citation- and editor-aware systems关闭综合和写作环境之间的循环。调查Gclose the loop between synthesis and the writing environment. SurveyG[137]通过分层遍历构建三层引文图（Foundation/Development/Frontier），Citegeistconstructs a three-layer citation graph (Foundation/Development/Frontier) with hierarchical traversal, Citegeist[11]在 arXiv 语料库和 CiteLLM 上构建动态 RAG 管道builds a dynamic RAG pipeline on the arXiv corpus, and CiteLLM[65]将无幻觉的参考发现直接嵌入到 LaTeX 编辑器中。开源系统，例如 GPT Researcherembeds hallucination-free reference discovery directly inside a LaTeX editor. Open-source systems such as GPT Researcher[38], 论文质量保证, PaperQA[128]和聊天纸, and ChatPaper[124]进一步说明文献综合工具在受控研究原型之外的实际应用日益广泛。然而，引文保真度仍然是一个瓶颈：ScholarCopilotfurther illustrate the growing practical adoption of literature synthesis tools beyond controlled research prototypes. However, citation fidelity remains a bottleneck: ScholarCopilot[215]仅报告reports only40.1%40.1\%顶-top-11引用准确性，这表明生成合理的相关工作文本仍然比将每个声明建立在正确的来源上更容易。citation accuracy, suggesting that generating plausible related-work text is still easier than grounding each claim in the correct source.

3.2.3 深度研究代理Deep Research Agents

深度研究代理与单遍检索或调查生成系统不同，它将文献探索视为一种Deep research agents differ from single-pass retrieval or survey-generation systems by treating literature exploration as an迭代的、代理的iterative, agentic过程。给定一个开放式查询，他们会计划子查询、检索和读取源、更新其内部状态，并继续下去，直到可以足够自信地合成报告为止。与单一检索模型相比，这种循环使深度研究代理更接近于长期信息搜索的工作流程。process. Given an open-ended query, they plan sub-queries, retrieve and read sources, update their internal state, and continue until a report can be synthesized with sufficient confidence. This loop makes deep research agents closer to a workflow for long-horizon information seeking than a single retrieval model.

商业系统Commercial systems已经普及了这种广泛信息综合的范式。 OpenAI Deep Research、Google Deep Research、Perplexity 和 Elicit 都支持多源检索和报告生成，尽管它们在延迟、引用风格、交互性和目标用例方面有所不同。have popularized this paradigm for broad information synthesis. OpenAI Deep Research, Google Deep Research, Perplexity, and Elicit all support multi-source retrieval and report generation, though they differ in latency, citation style, interactivity, and target use cases.开源文献专用系统Open-source literature-specific systems将这种范式应用到科学研究中。开放学者adapt this paradigm to scientific research. OpenScholar[9]发表在 Nature 上的 LM 是一种检索增强的 LM，可以搜索大规模开放获取的科学语料库，并且在科学文献基准上优于 PaperQA2 和 Perplexity Pro。统一深研, published in Nature, is a retrieval-augmented LM that searches large-scale open-access scientific corpora and outperforms PaperQA2 and Perplexity Pro on scientific literature benchmarks. Tongyi DeepResearch[7]来自阿里巴巴的法学硕士是一位代理法学硕士，专门从事长期深度信息搜索，在深度研究基准上取得了优异的成绩。from Alibaba is an agentic LLM specialized for long-horizon deep information seeking, achieving strong results on deep research benchmarks.

培训时代的方法Training-era approaches针对限制长期研究代理的数据和优化瓶颈。 O-研究员target the data and optimization bottlenecks that limit long-horizon research agents. O-Researcher[239]将多智能体蒸馏与智能体强化学习相结合，以提高基准性能，而 OpenResearchercombines multi-agent distillation with agentic reinforcement learning to improve benchmark performance, while OpenResearcher[108]通过在大型文档集合上构建离线轨迹合成管道来解决轨迹数据瓶颈。这些合成的轨迹为训练研究人员提供了长期的工具使用监督。addresses the trajectory-data bottleneck by constructing an offline trajectory synthesis pipeline over large document collections. These synthesized trajectories provide long-horizon tool-use supervision for training research agents.以领域为中心的变体Domain-focused variants对于专门的合成任务仍然很重要：CHIMEremain important for specialized synthesis tasks: CHIME[68]提供法学硕士协助的科学研究分层组织，以及 ASReviewprovides LLM-assisted hierarchical organization of scientific studies, and ASReview[207]发表在《自然机器智能》上，使用基于主动学习的筛选来减少系统审查中的人工工作，同时保持召回率。总的来说，深度研究代理涵盖了从轻量级事实查找到长期自主综合的范围，但越来越集中在相同的迭代架构上：计划、检索、读取、更新和综合。, published in Nature Machine Intelligence, uses active-learning-based screening to reduce manual effort in systematic reviews while maintaining recall. Collectively, deep research agents span a spectrum from lightweight factual lookup to long-horizon autonomous synthesis, but increasingly converge on the same iterative architecture: plan, retrieve, read, update, and synthesize.

3.2.4 评估：检索和合成质量Assessment: Retrieval and Synthesis Quality

评价已从Evaluation has shifted from检索准确率retrieval accuracy单独（“系统是否找到了正确的论文？”）走向更广泛的领域alone (“did the system find the right papers?”) toward broader合成质量synthesis quality（“它是否产生了有用、准确且组织良好的评论？”）。在输出层面，DeepScholar-Bench(“did it produce a useful, accurate, and well-organized review?”). At the output level, DeepScholar-Bench[149]为研究综合的覆盖范围、连贯性和事实准确性建立了专门的基准。报告台establishes a dedicated benchmark for research synthesis across coverage, coherence, and factual accuracy. ReportBench[103]将此方向扩展到根据调查式提示得出的深入研究报告。scales this direction to deep research reports derived from survey-style prompts.

在流程层面，ScholarGymAt the process level, ScholarGym[179]通过将深度研究的信息收集阶段分解为查询规划、工具调用和相关性评估，将其隔离开来。这是评估的早期步骤isolates the information-gathering stage of deep research by decomposing it into query planning, tool invocation, and relevance assessment. This is an early step toward evaluating如何how系统得出其答案，而不是仅判断最终输出。基准也开始探讨文学能力的结构和互动维度。科学网基准a system reaches its answer, rather than judging only the final output. Benchmarks have also begun probing structural and interactive dimensions of literature competence. SciNetBench[176]为大规模人工智能文献的文献检索代理引入了关系感知基准，表明关系感知检索的准确性通常较低。 IDR基准introduces a relation-aware benchmark for literature retrieval agents over large-scale AI literature, revealing that relation-aware retrieval accuracy often remains low. IDRBench[40]通过交互式深度研究任务和按需用户交互来解决人机交互的问题。addresses the human-in-the-loop dimension through interactive deep research tasks with on-demand user interaction.

通过这些努力，四个评估维度已经具体化：Across these efforts, four evaluation dimensions have crystallized:引用准确性citation accuracy，参考文献是否正确归属并忠实支持相关主张；, whether references are correctly attributed and faithfully support the associated claims;覆盖完整性coverage completeness，审查是否抓住了相关情况而没有重大遗漏；, whether the review captures the relevant landscape without major omissions;叙事连贯性narrative coherence、综合是否具有逻辑流程、主题组织和可读性；和, whether the synthesis has logical flow, thematic organization, and readability; and事实依据factual grounding，主张是否得到引用证据的支持而不是幻觉。调查X, whether claims are supported by cited evidence rather than hallucinated. SurveyX[110]通过将内容质量、结构质量和引用准确性作为单独的轴进行评估，例证了这种多维视图。主要的开放挑战是开发与专家对综合质量的判断相关的自动化指标，同时在跨领域、场所和写作风格中保持稳健。exemplifies this multi-dimensional view by evaluating content quality, structure quality, and citation accuracy as separate axes. The main open challenge is to develop automated metrics that correlate with expert judgment on synthesis quality while remaining robust across domains, venues, and writing styles.

3.2.5 调查结果和观察结果Findings and Observations

3.3 编码和实验Coding and Experiments

此阶段将研究想法转化为可执行的实施、运行实验并分析所得证据。与文献综述相比，编码和实验需要人工智能系统与外部环境交互：存储库、依赖项、数据集、计算资源、测试套件和评估脚本。现有的工作涵盖一般代码生成、论文到代码的翻译、实验编排和结果分析。在这些方向上，核心挑战不是法学硕士是否能够编写合理的代码，而是他们是否能够产生语义上正确的研究实现、执行有意义的实验并可靠地解释结果。This stage translates research ideas into executable implementations, runs experiments, and analyzes the resulting evidence. Compared with literature review, coding and experimentation require AI systems to interact with external environments: repositories, dependencies, datasets, compute resources, test suites, and evaluation scripts. Existing work spans general code generation, paper-to-code translation, experiment orchestration, and result analysis. Across these directions, the central challenge is not whether LLMs can write plausible code, but whether they can produce semantically correct research implementations, execute meaningful experiments, and interpret results reliably.

提供了编码和实验系统的全面清单A comprehensive inventory of coding and experiment systems is provided intable˜5（附录）。(Appendix).

3.3.1 代码生成Code Generation

通用代码生成已经成为当前法学硕士最成熟的能力之一。在 SWE 工作台上验证General-purpose code generation has become one of the most mature capabilities of current LLMs. On SWE-bench Verified[195]，评估现实世界的 GitHub 问题解决方案，前沿系统现在超过, which evaluates real-world GitHub issue resolution, frontier systems now exceed76%76\%。代理框架在这一进展中发挥了核心作用。 SWE代理. Agent frameworks have played a central role in this progress. SWE-agent[230]建立了established the代理-计算机接口agent–computer interface范例，为法学硕士提供对文件、测试和工具调用的结构化访问，而不是依赖于非结构化的 shell 交互。张开双手paradigm, giving LLMs structured access to files, tests, and tool calls rather than relying on unstructured shell interaction. OpenHands[212]将这一方向扩展为软件工程代理的通用开放平台，并已成为面向编码的工作流程的共同支柱。extends this direction into a general open platform for software engineering agents and has become a common backbone for coding-oriented workflows.

然而，标准软件基准测试的高性能并不直接意味着研究编码已准备就绪。 SWE-bench Verified 受到潜在污染的质疑，更具挑战性的变体暴露出更尖锐的局限性：性能下降到However, high performance on standard software benchmarks does not directly imply readiness for research coding. SWE-bench Verified has been questioned for potential contamination, and more challenging variants expose a sharper limitation: performance drops to23%23\%在 SWE-bench Pro 上on SWE-bench Pro[37]和and25%25\%在 SWE-EVO 上on SWE-EVO[201]。这些结果表明，当任务熟悉、支架良好或模式可匹配时，标准基准可能会高估鲁棒性。这种区别在研究环境中变得更加明显，其目标不仅是修复现有软件，而且是实现未指定的算法、重现隐式设计选择以及验证科学主张。. These results suggest that standard benchmarks may overestimate robustness when tasks are familiar, well-scaffolded, or pattern-matchable. This distinction becomes more pronounced in research settings, where the target is not only to fix existing software but to implement underspecified algorithms, reproduce implicit design choices, and validate scientific claims.

3.3.2 纸到代码Paper-to-Code

论文到代码的翻译是一种特定于研究的代码生成形式。它比传统的软件工程更难，因为研究论文经常混合自然语言描述、方程、伪代码、消融细节和领域约定，同时隐含关键的实现选择。纸码机Paper-to-code translation is a research-specific form of code generation. It is harder than conventional software engineering because research papers often mix natural-language descriptions, equations, pseudocode, ablation details, and domain conventions, while leaving key implementation choices implicit. PaperCoder[174]通过用于规划、分析和代码生成的三阶段多代理框架来解决此设置，将 ML 论文转换为可执行存储库。addresses this setting with a three-stage multi-agent framework for planning, analysis, and code generation, transforming ML papers into executable repositories.

专门的基准测试量化了这种设置仍然存在的困难程度。研究代码平台Dedicated benchmarks quantify how difficult this setting remains. ResearchCodeBench[71]评估法学硕士evaluates LLMs on212212新颖的 ML 实现任务，其中最佳报告模型仅实现novel ML implementation tasks, where the best reported model achieves only37.3%37.3\%准确性；值得注意的是，accuracy; notably,58.6%58.6\%错误是语义性的，这意味着生成的代码可以运行，但实现了错误的算法或行为。 SciReplicate-Benchof errors are semantic, meaning that the generated code runs but implements the wrong algorithm or behavior. SciReplicate-Bench[224]报告了类似的上限reports a similar ceiling of39%39\%跨越across100100任务来自tasks from3636NLP 论文。科学代码NLP papers. SciCode[203]将研究级编码评估扩展到数学、物理和化学，而 PaperBenchextends research-level coding evaluation to mathematics, physics, and chemistry, while PaperBench[192]将 20 篇 ICML 2024 论文分解为可单独评分的子任务，涵盖环境设置、实验执行和结果再现。这些基准测试共同揭示了一般软件问题解决和忠实研究实施之间的巨大差距。decomposes 20 ICML 2024 papers into individually gradable subtasks covering environment setup, experiment execution, and result reproduction. Together, these benchmarks reveal a substantial gap between general software issue resolution and faithful research implementation.

在高端，FunSearchAt the high end, FunSearch[161]证明了法学硕士生成的程序嵌入到进化搜索循环中时可以为真正的数学发现做出贡献。这一结果很重要，但它也澄清了当前能力的边界：成功不仅仅来自原始的一次性代码生成，还来自与积极搜索、评估和选择的耦合生成。熟悉的软件基准测试的强劲性能与新颖的研究代码的低得多的性能之间的对比决定了这一阶段的能力悬崖。demonstrates that LLM-generated programs can contribute to genuine mathematical discovery when embedded inside an evolutionary search loop. This result is important, but it also clarifies the boundary of current capability: success comes not from raw one-shot code generation alone, but from coupling generation with aggressive search, evaluation, and selection. The resulting contrast between strong performance on familiar software benchmarks and much lower performance on novel research code defines the capability cliff of this stage.

3.3.3 实验执行和编排Experiment Execution and Orchestration

一旦代码可用，下一个挑战就是系统且高效地运行实验。实验编排系统提供用于规划运行、修改代码、启动作业、监控结果和迭代故障的基础设施。 MLAgentBenchOnce the code is available, the next challenge is to run experiments systematically and efficiently. Experiment orchestration systems provide infrastructure for planning runs, modifying code, launching jobs, monitoring results, and iterating over failures. MLAgentBench[73]评估 ML 实验中的语言代理； MLR-副驾驶evaluates language agents on ML experimentation; MLR-Copilot[104]将自主研究分为想法代理和实验代理； DS代理separates autonomous research into idea and experiment agents; DS-Agent[58]针对端到端数据科学工作流程；和助手targets end-to-end data-science workflows; and AIDE[81]将机器学习工程框架为代码空间中的树搜索。更广泛的评估环境，包括 MLR-Benchframes ML engineering as tree search in code space. Broader evaluation environments, including MLR-Bench[24], MLE 工作台, MLE-Bench[20], MLGym [135]和居里, and CURIE[91]，为测量自主实验提供日益标准化的测试平台。, provide increasingly standardized testbeds for measuring autonomous experimentation.

最近的系统将这一基础设施推向更高吞吐量和闭环研究工作流程。研发代理Recent systems push this infrastructure toward higher-throughput and closed-loop research workflows. R&D-Agent[233]使用研究人员-开发人员双代理设计进行机器学习实验，而 Karpathy 的自动研究uses a Researcher-Developer dual-agent design for ML experimentation, while Karpathy’s autoresearch[87]演示高通量实验迭代。闭环系统，例如 CodeScientistdemonstrates high-throughput experiment iteration. Closed-loop systems such as CodeScientist[77], 海豚, Dolphin[244]、和小说搜索, and NovelSeek[248]尝试将假设生成、实施、执行和验证联系起来。进化科学家attempt to connect hypothesis generation, implementation, execution, and verification. EvoScientist[127]通过报告通过自我发展的研究渠道生成的已接受论文，进一步说明了这一方向的雄心。这些系统表明，实验吞吐量和工作流程自动化正在迅速提高，但其可靠性仍然在很大程度上取决于任务脚手架、基准设计和验证质量。further illustrates the ambition of this direction by reporting accepted papers generated through a self-evolving research pipeline. These systems show that experimental throughput and workflow automation are improving rapidly, but their reliability still depends heavily on task scaffolding, benchmark design, and verification quality.

互补的工作线将执行与搜索和学习信号结合起来。阿尔法进化A complementary line of work couples execution with search and learning signals. AlphaEvolve[140]通过 LLM 生成的突变和自动评估改进算法。硅improves algorithms through LLM-generated mutations and automated evaluation. Si等人。et al. [185]将基于执行的搜索与大规模并行 GPU 实验结合使用，性能优于 GRPO 基线。科学导航use execution-grounded search with large-scale parallel GPU experiments, outperforming GRPO baselines. SciNav[253]使用成对树搜索判断来选择有希望的分支，而 Yuksekgonuluses pairwise tree-search judgments to select promising branches, while Yuksekgonul等人。et al. [245]将测试时训练和强化学习相结合，以持续改进数学、GPU 内核优化和计算生物学。自动再现combine test-time training and reinforcement learning for continuous improvement across mathematics, GPU kernel optimization, and computational biology. AutoReproduce[259]解决了一个不同但相关的问题：通过从论文谱系中提取隐含知识来重现引用的实验。addresses a different but related problem: reproducing cited experiments by extracting implicit knowledge from paper lineages.

特定领域的系统说明了当环境是科学的而不是纯粹的计算环境时编排如何变化。在化学领域，CoscientistDomain-specific systems illustrate how orchestration changes when the environment is scientific rather than purely computational. In chemistry, Coscientist[15]和化学乌鸦and ChemCrow[17]使用法学硕士驱动的工具来支持自主研究工作流程。在生物学中，AlphaFold 3use LLM-driven tools to support autonomous research workflows. In biology, AlphaFold 3[1]将蛋白质结构预测扩展到生物分子复合物，而 CRISPR-GPTextends protein structure prediction to biomolecular complexes, while CRISPR-GPT[156], 生物规划师, BioPlanner[141]，和实验室工作台, and LAB-Bench[96]目标基因编辑设计、方案规划和生物学研究评估。对于系统级优化，KernelBenchtarget gene-editing design, protocol planning, and biology research evaluation. For systems-level optimization, KernelBench[143]和 TritonBenchand TritonBench[101]评估 LLM 是否可以生成高效的 GPU 内核和 Triton 算子。跨域套件，例如 AstaBenchevaluate whether LLMs can generate efficient GPU kernels and Triton operators. Cross-domain suites such as AstaBench[16]和 EXP 工作台and EXP-Bench[92]将评估范围扩大到多领域科学任务和自主实验执行。broaden evaluation to multi-domain scientific tasks and autonomous experiment execution.

总体而言，执行层进步很快，特别是当任务明确且反馈自动化时。更难的问题是实验Overall, the execution layer has advanced quickly, especially when tasks are well specified and feedback is automated. The harder problem is experiment规划planning：决定哪些实验值得运行、按什么顺序运行以及如何解释失败。当前的许多系统在规定的任务池上表现良好，但在要求选择真正新颖的研究方向时仍然不太可靠。从这个意义上说，编码和实验揭示了与想法生成相同的更广泛的模式：执行能力的提高速度快于决定应该执行什么所需的科学判断。: deciding which experiments are worth running, in what order, and how to interpret failures. Many current systems perform well on prescribed task pools, but remain less reliable when asked to choose genuinely novel research directions. In this sense, coding and experimentation expose the same broader pattern as idea generation: execution capability is improving faster than the scientific judgment needed to decide what should be executed.

3.3.4 评估：代码正确性和可重复性Assessment: Code Correctness and Reproducibility

评估编码和实验系统需要的不仅仅是检查生成的代码是否运行。研究代码必须实现预期的算法，重现报告的结果，支持有意义的消融，并生成可以正确解释的证据。这使得语义正确性和可重复性成为核心评估标准。Assessing coding and experiment systems requires more than checking whether the generated code runs. Research code must implement the intended algorithm, reproduce reported results, support meaningful ablations, and generate evidence that can be interpreted correctly. This makes semantic correctness and reproducibility central evaluation criteria.

几个基准暴露了这个解释层的困难。发现台Several benchmarks expose the difficulty of this interpretive layer. DiscoveryBench[130]和科学代理台and ScienceAgentBench[32]评估实验数据的科学推理，表明法学硕士仍然难以对复杂结果集进行多步骤分析。探索世界evaluate scientific reasoning over experimental data, showing that LLMs still struggle with multi-step analysis over complex result sets. DiscoveryWorld[76]提供了一个虚拟环境provides a virtual environment with120120自动化科学发现代理的挑战任务。 InfiAgent-DABenchchallenge tasks for automated scientific discovery agents. InfiAgent-DABench[70]对端到端数据分析工作流程进行基准测试，包括跨不同领域的数据清理、统计测试和可视化生成。benchmarks end-to-end data-analysis workflows, including data cleaning, statistical testing, and visualization generation across diverse domains.

核心瓶颈是从原始输出转向可信声明。当前的系统通常可以生成图表、汇总统计数据和局部解释，但它们在识别统计上有意义的趋势、诊断故障模式、设计决定性的消融以及将结果合成为连贯的经验论点方面不太可靠。这种限制尤其重要，因为编码错误和实验误解可能会传播到后来的写作和评论阶段，在这些阶段，精美的叙述可能会掩盖薄弱或不正确的证据。The core bottleneck is moving from raw outputs to trustworthy claims. Current systems can often produce plots, summary statistics, and local interpretations, but they are less reliable at identifying statistically meaningful trends, diagnosing failure modes, designing decisive ablations, and synthesizing results into a coherent empirical argument. This limitation is particularly consequential because coding errors and experimental misinterpretations can propagate into later writing and review stages, where polished narratives may obscure weak or incorrect evidence.

3.3.5 调查结果和观察结果Findings and Observations

3.4 表格和数字Tables and Figures

表格和图形将实验输出、统计摘要、算法和概念设计转化为可发表的研究成果。现有系统涵盖科学图形生成、数据可视化、表格构建、公式生成和算法说明。与编码和实验相比，这个阶段更多的是忠实地呈现证据，而不是产生新证​​据。在这些工件类型中，核心挑战是之间的差距Tables and figures transform experimental outputs, statistical summaries, algorithms, and conceptual designs into publication-ready research artifacts. Existing systems cover scientific figure generation, data visualization, table construction, formula generation, and algorithmic illustration. Compared with coding and experimentation, this stage is less about producing new evidence than about representing evidence faithfully. Across these artifact types, the central challenge is the gap between视觉合理性visual plausibility和and科学正确性scientific correctness：人工智能生成的输出可能看起来很专业，但包含不正确的标签、误导性布局、无效的数字关系或特定领域的符号错误。: AI-generated outputs may look professional while containing incorrect labels, misleading layouts, invalid numerical relationships, or domain-specific notation errors.

提供了图形和表格生成系统的全面清单A comprehensive inventory of figure and table generation systems is provided intable˜6（附录）。(Appendix).

3.4.1 科学图形生成Scientific Figure Generation

科学图形生成涵盖方法图、架构插图、结果图、数据可视化和流程图。标准结果图相对容易处理，因为它们通常可以基于结构化数据和可执行绘图代码。相比之下，方法图和框架图更难，因为它们需要忠实的空间组织、正确的信息流、特定领域的符号和特定于论文的视觉约定。Scientific figure generation spans method diagrams, architecture illustrations, result plots, data visualizations, and pipeline figures. Standard result plots are comparatively tractable because they can often be grounded in structured data and executable plotting code. In contrast, method diagrams and framework figures are harder because they require faithful spatial organization, correct information flow, domain-specific symbols, and paper-specific visual conventions.

对于For方法和架构图method and architecture diagrams、自动图形编辑, AutoFigure-Edit[114]从长文本生成可编辑的文本到 SVG 科学插图，使用户能够修改生成的图形，而不是将它们视为固定图像。其配套系统 AutoFiguregenerates editable text-to-SVG scientific illustrations from long-form text, enabling users to revise generated figures rather than treating them as fixed images. Its companion system AutoFigure[269]引入了用于生成和完善面向出版的科学插图的FigureBench。纸香蕉introduces FigureBench for generating and refining publication-oriented scientific illustrations. PaperBanana[267]采用多个专门代理进行检索、规划、样式化、可视化和评论，而 StarVectoremploys multiple specialized agents for retrieval, planning, styling, visualization, and critique, while StarVector[160]专注于来自文本描述的可缩放矢量图形。这些系统共同展示了从静态图像生成到可编辑、结构化和批判意识图形构建的转变。focuses on scalable vector graphics from textual descriptions. Together, these systems show a shift from static image generation toward editable, structured, and critique-aware figure construction.

对于For结果图和数据可视化result plots and data visualization, MatPlotAgent [235]使用基于 VLM 的视觉反馈来提高数据可视化质量，而 PlotGenuses VLM-based visual feedback to improve data visualization quality, while PlotGen[53]和情节工艺and PlotCraft[252]研究不同情节类型和任务难度的图表生成。科达study chart generation across diverse plot types and task difficulties. CoDA[31]探索可视化的多代理协作和 ChartGPTexplores multi-agent collaboration for visualization, and ChartGPT[204]将图表生成分解为处理抽象自然语言输入的顺序推理步骤。最近的系统扩大了生成和评估的范围：SciFigdecomposes chart generation into sequential reasoning steps for handling abstract natural-language inputs. More recent systems broaden the scope of generation and evaluation: SciFig[74]引入了基于标题的管道图评估，VisCoderintroduces rubric-based evaluation for pipeline figures, VisCoder[139]研究大规模基于代码的可视化生成，DiagramAgentstudies code-based visualization generation at scale, DiagramAgent[218]使用专门的代理和 SciFlow-Bench 来定位多个图表类别targets multiple diagram categories with specialized agents, and SciFlow-Bench[255]通过结构优先分析评估科学框架数据。这些努力表明，标准数据图越来越容易处理，而复杂的框架图仍然很困难，因为它们需要结构一致性而不仅仅是视觉吸引力。evaluates scientific framework figures through structure-first analysis. These efforts indicate that standard data plots are increasingly tractable, while complex framework figures remain difficult because they require structural consistency rather than only visual appeal.

对于For图形编辑与优化figure editing and optimization, VIS-牧羊人, VIS-Shepherd[145]为基于 LLM 的数据可视化提供建设性反馈，强调批评和修订，而不是单独直接生成。provides constructive feedback for LLM-based data visualization, emphasizing critique and revision rather than direct generation alone.[22]调查出版商对人工智能生成数据的政策，并提出负责任使用的最佳实践指南。 SAIL框架surveys publisher policies on AI-generated figures and proposes best-practice guidelines for responsible use. The SAIL framework[172]将领域逻辑与代码语法分开，使研究人员能够保留科学监督，同时将实现细节委托给人工智能。在这些系统中，新兴的设计原则是人为指导的细化：人工智能可以加速布局、渲染、样式和可访问性的改进，但研究人员必须验证图形是否忠实地代表了底层方法或数据。separates domain logic from code syntax, allowing researchers to retain scientific oversight while delegating implementation details to AI. Across these systems, the emerging design principle is human-guided refinement: AI can accelerate layout, rendering, styling, and accessibility improvements, but researchers must verify whether the figure faithfully represents the underlying method or data.

3.4.2 表理解和生成Table Understanding and Generation

表生成跨越两个互补的任务：理解现有表和创建新表。在理解方面，Chain-of-TableTable generation spans two complementary tasks: understanding existing tables and creating new ones. On the understanding side, Chain-of-Table[216]通过多步表转换执行表推理，反映了许多表任务需要顺序操作而不是单遍提取的事实。在生成方面，ArxivDIGETablesperforms table reasoning through multi-step table transformations, reflecting the fact that many table tasks require sequential operations rather than single-pass extraction. On the generation side, ArxivDIGESTables[136]将科学文献综合成结构化比较表，ShowTablesynthesizes scientific literature into structured comparison tables, ShowTable[121]引入了创意表格可视化的协作反思和细化，以及 Table2LaTeX-RLintroduces collaborative reflection and refinement for creative table visualization, and Table2LaTeX-RL[115]使用增强的多模式语言模型将表格图像转换为 LaTeX 代码。converts table images into LaTeX code using reinforced multimodal language models.

与标准图形生成相比，表格生成仍然不太成熟，因为科学表格必须满足更严格的语义约束。比较表需要一致的轴、公平的方法分组、完整的引文覆盖率和正确的数字转录。消融表的要求甚至更高，因为它们编码实验设计选择，而不仅仅是最终结果。艾比基因Compared with standard figure generation, table generation remains less mature because scientific tables must satisfy stricter semantic constraints. Comparison tables require consistent axes, fair grouping of methods, complete citation coverage, and correct numerical transcription. Ablation tables are even more demanding because they encode experimental design choices, not only final results. AbGen[260]使用 NLP 论文中专家注释的示例评估法学硕士的消融研究设计，揭示了法学硕士生成的表格计划与人类专家判断之间的显着差距。这表明表生成不仅仅是一个格式问题；而且是一个问题。它需要了解哪些比较具有科学意义以及应如何组织证据。evaluates LLMs on ablation study design using expert-annotated examples from NLP papers, revealing a significant gap between LLM-generated table plans and human expert judgments. This suggests that table generation is not merely a formatting problem; it requires understanding which comparisons are scientifically meaningful and how evidence should be organized.

3.4.3 数学公式和算法伪代码Mathematical Formulas and Algorithm Pseudocode

数学公式、TikZ 图和算法伪代码是科学推理的紧凑表示，这使得它们对小错误特别敏感。与普通的散文或标准图表不同，这些工件同时需要精确的语法和精确的语义：放错位置的符号、索引、运算符、箭头或依赖项可能会改变方法的含义。因此，公式和伪代码生成的鲁棒性仍然不如自然语言润色或标准可视化。Mathematical formulas, TikZ diagrams, and algorithm pseudocode are compact representations of scientific reasoning, making them particularly sensitive to small errors. Unlike ordinary prose or standard charts, these artifacts require exact syntax and exact semantics simultaneously: a misplaced symbol, index, operator, arrow, or dependency can change the meaning of the method. As a result, formula and pseudocode generation remain less robust than natural-language polishing or standard visualization.

最近的系统通过专门的数据集、多模式输入和迭代细化来解决这一挑战。自动化TikZRecent systems address this challenge through specialized datasets, multimodal inputs, and iterative refinement. AutomaTikZ[12]介绍了 DaTikZ（一个大规模 TikZ 数据集），并表明微调模型在科学矢量图形方面可以优于通用 LLM。 DeTikZifyintroduces DaTikZ, a large-scale TikZ dataset, and shows that fine-tuned models can outperform general-purpose LLMs on scientific vector graphics. DeTikZify[13]通过多模式输入和基于 MCTS 的迭代细化在更大的 TikZ 图形集合上扩展了这条线。提克齐拉extends this line with multimodal input and MCTS-based iterative refinement over a larger collection of TikZ graphics. TikZilla[56]进一步表明，具有监督微调和强化学习的特定领域训练可以使较小的开源模型在 TikZ 生成上与较大的通用模型竞争。专家further suggests that domain-specific training with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning can make smaller open-source models competitive with larger general-purpose models on TikZ generation. TeXpert[85]强调了剩下的困难：随着 LaTeX 任务变得更加复杂，准确性急剧下降，特别是对于具有合并单元格、嵌套环境和重要格式约束的表格。这些结果强化了表格和图形生成的更广泛模式：专门的培训和迭代细化有所帮助，但当视觉或符号工件具有科学意义时，人工验证仍然是必要的。highlights the remaining difficulty: accuracy drops sharply as LaTeX tasks become more complex, especially for tables with merged cells, nested environments, and nontrivial formatting constraints. These results reinforce the broader pattern of table and figure generation: specialized training and iterative refinement help, but human verification remains necessary when visual or symbolic artifacts carry scientific meaning.

3.4.4 评估：视觉保真度和科学准确性Assessment: Visual Fidelity and Scientific Accuracy

对表格和图形生成的评估必须评估两者Evaluation for table and figure generation must assess both视觉保真度visual fidelity和and科学准确scientific accuracy。视觉保真度询问工件是否可读、美观连贯且符合出版惯例。科学准确性询​​问工件是否忠实地代表了基础数据、方法、比较或数学关系。区别至关重要：人工智能生成的图形可能看起来很专业，但同时包含未对齐的箭头、不正确的标签、无效的定量关系或特定领域的符号错误。. Visual fidelity asks whether an artifact is readable, aesthetically coherent, and consistent with publication conventions. Scientific accuracy asks whether the artifact faithfully represents the underlying data, method, comparison, or mathematical relation. The distinction is crucial: an AI-generated figure may look professional while containing misaligned arrows, incorrect labels, invalid quantitative relationships, or domain-specific notation errors.

最近的基准越来越多地针对这一差距。 SciFlow-工作台Recent benchmarks increasingly target this gap. SciFlow-Bench[255]使用逆向解析评估来检测结构不正确但视觉上合理的框架图。图台uses inverse-parsing evaluation to detect structurally incorrect but visually plausible framework figures. FigureBench[269]评估科学插图的生成和完善。情节工艺evaluates scientific illustration generation and refinement. PlotCraft[252]研究不同图表类型的图表生成，而 SciFigstudies chart generation across diverse chart types, while SciFig[74]为管道数据提供基于标准的评估。专家provides a rubric-based evaluation for pipeline figures. TeXpert[85]评估不同难度级别的 LaTeX 生成，揭示困难情况下性能急剧下降的情况。艾比基因evaluates LaTeX generation across difficulty levels, exposing steep performance degradation on hard cases. AbGen[260]将评估扩展到消融研究设计，其中的挑战不仅在于格式化表格，还在于选择具有科学意义的比较。extends evaluation to ablation study design, where the challenge is not only formatting a table but selecting scientifically meaningful comparisons.

不同工件类型的成熟度仍然参差不齐。标准结果图是最容易处理的，因为它们可以从结构化数据生成并通过可执行绘图代码进行验证。方法图和框架图仍然更难，因为它们需要空间组织和语义一致性。当表格编码比较逻辑或消融设计而不是简单的格式化时，表格就很困难。数学公式、TikZ 图和伪代码表现出陡峭的精度悬崖，因为小的语法错误可能会改变科学含义。这些基准共同表明Across artifact types, maturity remains uneven. Standard result plots are the most tractable because they can be generated from structured data and validated through executable plotting code. Method diagrams and framework figures remain harder because they require spatial organization and semantic consistency. Tables are difficult when they encode comparison logic or ablation design rather than simple formatting. Mathematical formulas, TikZ diagrams, and pseudocode exhibit steep accuracy cliffs because small syntactic errors can alter scientific meaning. Together, these benchmarks show that评估正在从基于外观的判断转向结构、语义和任务感知评估。evaluation is moving from appearance-based judgment toward structure-, semantics-, and task-aware assessment.

3.4.5 调查结果和观察结果Findings and Observations

3.5 总结与转变：创作Summary and Transition: Creation

四个创造阶段在实践中是紧密结合的。The four Creation stages are tightly coupled in practice. (创意产生Idea Generation）生成候选假设，) generates candidate hypotheses, (文献综述Literature Review）将它们置于之前的工作中，) situates them within prior work, (编码和实验Coding and Experiments）将它们转化为可执行的实现和经验证据，并且) turns them into executable implementations and empirical evidence, and (表格和数字Tables and Figures）将结果输出转换为视觉和结构化的工件以进行通信。这些阶段的进展呈现出一致的模式：人工智能系统在产生研究成果方面越来越有效，包括想法、文献摘要、代码、实验、图表和表格，但在验证这些成果是否新颖、忠实、可执行和具有科学意义方面仍然不太可靠。) converts the resulting outputs into visual and structured artifacts for communication. Progress across these stages shows a consistent pattern: AI systems are increasingly effective at producing the artifacts of research, including ideas, literature summaries, code, experiments, figures, and tables, but they remain less reliable at verifying whether these artifacts are novel, faithful, executable, and scientifically meaningful.

这种差距在每个阶段都有不同的表现。在This gap appears differently at each stage. In，看似新颖的东西在实施后往往会减弱。在, plausible novelty often weakens after implementation. In，流畅的合成可以掩盖引用错误或不完整的覆盖范围。在, fluent synthesis can conceal citation errors or incomplete coverage. In，可执行代码在语义上仍然可能是错误的，并且自动运行并不能保证有意义的实验设计。在, executable code can still be semantically wrong, and automated runs do not guarantee meaningful experimental design. In，精美的视觉工件可能会歪曲数据、符号或方法结构。这些故障模式表明，当与基础、执行反馈、明确验证和人类科学判断相结合时，创建阶段的自动化是最可信的。, polished visual artifacts may misrepresent data, notation, or methodological structure. These failure modes suggest that Creation-stage automation is most credible when coupled with grounding, execution feedback, explicit verification, and human scientific judgment.

第一阶段的输出（The outputs of Phase 1 (创造Creation) 构成第 2 阶段的原材料 () constitute the raw material for Phase 2 (写作Writing）。想法、检索到的文献、经过验证的实验、统计摘要、比较表和科学数据必须组织成一份连贯的手稿，解释其贡献，证明其重要性，并为外部审查做好准备。因此我们接下来转向). Ideas, retrieved literature, validated experiments, statistical summaries, comparison tables, and scientific figures must be organized into a coherent manuscript that explains the contribution, justifies its significance, and prepares it for external scrutiny. We therefore next turn to写作Writing，人工智能的帮助从生产研究成果转向将证据构建为学术论点。, where AI assistance shifts from producing research artifacts to structuring evidence into a scholarly argument.

4 第二阶段：写作Phase 2: Writing

此阶段由一个阶段组成：This phase consists of a single stage:论文写作Paper Writing ( ）。写作值得拥有自己的阶段，因为它将第一阶段产生的文物转化为学术论证。这不仅仅是一个格式化步骤：稿件必须选择证据、构建主张、在文献中定位贡献、以足够详细的方式解释方法以确保可重复性，并在第三阶段的外部审查之前预见到反对意见（). Writing merits its own phase because it transforms the artifacts produced in Phase 1 into a scholarly argument. It is not merely a formatting step: a manuscript must select evidence, structure claims, situate contributions in the literature, explain methods with sufficient detail for reproducibility, and anticipate objections before external scrutiny in Phase 3 (验证Validation）。与第一阶段相比（). Compared with Phase 1 (创造Creation），强调工件生产，第 2 阶段（), which emphasizes artifact production, Phase 2 (写作Writing）强调修辞组织和证据论证。) emphasizes rhetorical organization and evidential justification.

这种区别对于人工智能辅助研究很重要。写作工具是人工智能研究生态系统中采用最广泛的系统之一，涵盖语法纠正、句子润色、章节起草、引文支持和全文生成。与此同时，写作是道德上最敏感的阶段之一，因为作者身份、归属、披露以及援助和生成之间的界限等问题仍未解决。因此，核心挑战不是人工智能能否写出流畅的学术散文，而是它能否保持事实基础、论证深度、引文保真度和人类责任。This distinction matters for AI-assisted research. Writing tools are among the most widely adopted systems in the AI-for-research ecosystem, spanning grammar correction, sentence polishing, section drafting, citation support, and full-paper generation. At the same time, Writing is one of the most ethically sensitive phases because questions of authorship, attribution, disclosure, and the boundary between assistance and generation remain unresolved. The central challenge is therefore not whether AI can produce fluent academic prose, but whether it can preserve factual grounding, argumentative depth, citation fidelity, and human accountability.

4.1 论文写作Paper Writing

人工智能辅助写作已经从偶尔的支持转变为主流研究实践。大规模语料库分析估计可检测到的人工智能修改最多可达AI-assisted writing has moved from occasional support to mainstream research practice. Large-scale corpus analyses estimate detectable AI modification in up to17.5%17.5\%计算机科学文摘of computer science abstracts[109]和and13.5%13.5\%生物医学文摘of biomedical abstracts[90]，而自我报告的采用率更高：2025 年《自然》杂志的一项调查发现，超过一半的研究人员报告寻求人工智能写作帮助, while self-reported adoption is higher: a 2025 Nature survey found that more than half of researchers report seeking AI writing help[134]。这些测量并不完美，但它们共同表明了一个明显的转变：人工智能写作辅助现在已嵌入日常科学工作流程中。这使得人工智能辅助写作的质量、透明度和治理变得越来越重要。. These measurements are imperfect, but together they indicate a clear shift: AI writing assistance is now embedded in everyday scientific workflows. This makes the quality, transparency, and governance of AI-assisted writing increasingly important.

提供了人工智能辅助写作系统的全面清单A comprehensive inventory of AI-assisted writing systems is provided intable˜7（附录）。(Appendix).

4.1.1 半自动写作辅助Semi-Automated Writing Assistance

半自动写作辅助支持手稿工作流程的不同部分，从规划和起草到润色和修订。在规划阶段，系统帮助生成标题、大纲、章节结构和引文建议。学者副驾驶Semi-automated writing assistance supports different parts of the manuscript workflow, from planning and drafting to polishing and revision. At the planning stage, systems help generate titles, outlines, section structures, and citation suggestions. ScholarCopilot[215]例如，通过综合引文推荐来培训法学硕士进行学术写作，反映了将文本生成与文献基础相结合的工具的更广泛趋势。, for example, trains LLMs for academic writing with integrated citation recommendation, reflecting a broader trend toward tools that combine text generation with literature grounding.

在起草过程中，Grammarly、Writefull、Paperpal 和基于 GPT 的编辑器等商业工具支持段落生成、句子润色、引文插入和风格细化。开源提示模板During drafting, commercial tools such as Grammarly, Writefull, Paperpal, and GPT-based editors support paragraph generation, sentence polishing, citation insertion, and style refinement. Open-source prompt templates[106]提供轻量级替代方案，而 CoAuthorprovide lightweight alternatives, while CoAuthor[97]研究人类与人工智能协作写作工作流程。主导范式正日益从studies human–AI collaborative writing workflows. The dominant paradigm is increasingly shifting from“人工智能为你写作”“AI writes for you” to “AI与你一起书写”“AI writes with you”：人工智能处理机械或本地操作，例如润色、引文格式和初步起草，而研究人员保留新颖性、论证、实验解释和科学判断的责任。: AI handles mechanical or local operations, such as polishing, citation formatting, and initial drafting, while researchers retain responsibility for novelty, argumentation, experimental interpretation, and scientific judgment.

编辑集成系统使这种协作更加明确。纸质调试器Editor-integrated systems make this collaboration more explicit. PaperDebugger[67]将多代理系统嵌入到 Overleaf 中，在写作环境中运行 Reviewer、Enhancer、Scoring 和 Researcher 代理。互补的工作强调认知参与和透明度。脚本&Shiftembeds a multi-agent system into Overleaf, running Reviewer, Enhancer, Scoring, and Researcher agents within the writing environment. A complementary line of work emphasizes cognitive engagement and transparency. Script&Shift[186]围绕人工智能辅助写作构建structures AI-assisted writing around源变换source transformation而不是直接生成文本，旨在保留作者的主动推理。草稿标记rather than direct text generation, aiming to preserve the writer’s active reasoning. DraftMarks[188]提供修订强度和人工智能生成内容的视觉痕迹，使人类与人工智能的写作过程对读者和审稿人更加透明。经验证据provides visual traces of revision intensity and AI-generated content, making the human–AI writing process more transparent to readers and reviewers. Empirical evidence[187]进一步表明，有目的的人工智能支持可以帮助学生写作，而无需完全取代认知努力。further suggests that purposeful AI support can assist student writing without fully displacing cognitive effort.

后期写作系统注重修订、一致性和风格。 XtraGPTPost-writing systems focus on revision, consistency, and style. XtraGPT[25]提供开源 LLM 套件，用于指导指导的科学论文修订，SciIGprovides an open-source LLM suite for instruction-guided scientific paper revision, SciIG[46]使用最近的 NAACL 和 ICLR 论文 OpenDraft 对介绍写作进行基准测试benchmarks introduction writing using recent NAACL and ICLR papers, OpenDraft[36]使用专门的代理生成带有引文支持的长研究草稿，并且 LimAgentsuses specialized agents to generate long research drafts with citation support, and LimAgents[6]集成 OpenReview 评论和引文网络以生成研究限制声明。这些系统共同表明，半自动写作辅助在增强研究人员控制而不是取代框架、解释和辩护贡献的智力工作时是最可信的。integrates OpenReview comments and citation networks to generate research-limitation statements. Together, these systems show that semi-automated writing assistance is most credible when it augments researcher control rather than replaces the intellectual work of framing, interpreting, and defending a contribution.

4.1.2 全自动纸张生成Fully Automated Paper Generation

全自动纸张生成试图超越本地协助，转向端到端的手稿制作。现有系统可以分为三个方向。首先是端到端的研究系统，例如The AI ScientistFully automated paper generation attempts to move beyond local assistance toward end-to-end manuscript production. Existing systems can be grouped into three directions. First, end-to-end research systems such as The AI Scientist[122, 123]及代理实验室and Agent Laboratory[171]生成完整的论文作为更广泛的自动化研究渠道的一部分。这些系统展示了生产完整的纸质制品的可行性，但它们的输出往往仍然受到肤浅的论证、薄弱的实验验证或不够新颖的限制。generate full papers as part of broader automated research pipelines. These systems demonstrate the feasibility of producing complete paper-like artifacts, but their outputs often remain limited by shallow argumentation, weak experimental validation, or insufficient novelty.

其次，基准论文生成系统旨在接近人类审查标准。周期研究员Second, benchmarked paper-generation systems aim to approach human review standards. CycleResearcher[220]报告生成论文评分reports generated papers scoring5.365.36在 ICLR 规模上，接近但仍低于报告的接受论文平均水平on the ICLR scale, approaching but still below the reported accepted-paper average of5.695.69。这种差距很重要，因为它表明主要瓶颈不再仅仅是表面流畅性。相反，接近阈值的论文往往缺乏论证深度、实验严谨性和审稿人的预期，而这些正是可发表的作品与看似合理的草稿的区别。. This gap is important because it suggests that the main bottleneck is no longer surface fluency alone. Rather, near-threshold papers often lack the argumentative depth, experimental rigor, and reviewer anticipation that distinguish publishable work from plausible drafts.

第三，标题引导和特定部分的系统改进了部分手稿，而不是从头开始生成整篇论文。 APRESThird, rubric-guided and section-specific systems improve parts of the manuscript rather than generating the entire paper from scratch. APRES[257]发现预测引用计数的准则并相应地修改论文，人类专家更喜欢修改后的论文discovers rubrics predictive of citation counts and revises papers accordingly, with human experts preferring revised papers79%79\%的时间。未来一代of the time. FutureGen[5]目标是“未来工作”部分的生成。论文写作凳targets “Future Work” section generation. PaperWritingBench[191]作为 PaperOrchestra 框架的一部分引入，通过根据逆向工程顶级会议论文评估多代理系统，为自动论文写作提供了专用基准。这些系统表明自动写作越来越可衡量，但也强调高质量论文需要的不仅仅是流畅的文本：它们需要基于证据的推理和连贯的科学贡献。, introduced as part of the PaperOrchestra framework, provides a dedicated benchmark for automated paper writing by evaluating multi-agent systems against reverse-engineered top-tier conference papers. These systems indicate that automated writing is increasingly measurable, but also reinforce that high-quality papers require more than fluent text: they require evidence-grounded reasoning and coherent scientific contribution.

4.1.3 评估：写作质量和人工智能检测Assessment: Writing Quality and AI Detection

对人工智能辅助写作的评估涉及两个相关但又不同的问题：人工智能的使用是否可以被检测到，以及由此产生的手稿是否具有科学性。检测作为治理机制仍然不可靠。当前的检测器可能会产生不可接受的误报，特别是对于正式的、非母语的或经过高度编辑的学术散文，这促使主要场所从尝试Assessment of AI-assisted writing involves two related but distinct questions: whether AI use can be detected, and whether the resulting manuscript is scientifically strong. Detection remains unreliable as a governance mechanism. Current detectors can produce unacceptable false positives, especially for formal, non-native, or highly edited academic prose, motivating a shift at major venues from attempting to检测detect人工智能的使用要求作者AI use toward requiring authors to声明declare人工智能的使用。水印在受控设置下提供了更有原则的路线AI use. Watermarking offers a more principled route under controlled settings[159]，但它需要模型提供商的合作，并且仍然容易受到释义、翻译和后期编辑的影响。, but it requires model-provider cooperation and remains vulnerable to paraphrasing, translation, and post-editing.

质量评价更重要，但也更难。好的学术写作必须从多个维度进行评估：事实正确性、引用准确性、论证连贯性、方法论完整性、框架新颖性和文体适当性。法学硕士作为法官的框架越来越多地用于近似评估的部分内容。周期审阅者Quality evaluation is more important, but also harder. Good academic writing must be assessed along multiple dimensions: factual correctness, citation accuracy, argumentative coherence, methodological completeness, novelty of framing, and stylistic appropriateness. LLM-as-Judge frameworks are increasingly used to approximate parts of this evaluation. CycleReviewer[220]报告一个reports a26.89%26.89\%相对于单个人类审稿人进行分数预测，代理 MAE 减少，而斯坦福代理审稿人reduction in Proxy MAE relative to individual human reviewers for score prediction, while the Stanford Agentic Reviewer[80]实现与人类评分者间一致性相当的评论评分相关性（achieves review-score correlations comparable to human inter-rater agreement (ρ=0.42\rho=0.42与人类相比vs. humanρ=0.41\rho=0.41）。这些结果表明，自动评估器可以提供有用的评论式信号，但不应将它们视为专家评估的替代品：分数预测和一致性指标仅部分捕获事实基础、证据严谨性、新颖性和科学贡献。). These results suggest that automated evaluators can provide useful review-style signals, but they should not be treated as substitutes for expert assessment: score prediction and agreement metrics only partially capture factual grounding, evidential rigor, novelty, and scientific contribution.

因此，人工智能写作的主要失败模式不是不语法的散文，而是缺乏支持的说服力：文本流畅、结构良好、类似引文，但缺乏证据或科学判断的依据。最近研究中观察到的生产力与质量差异进一步放大了这个问题：人工智能的使用可以增加出版物产出，但人工智能辅助的语言复杂的论文可能不太可能被接受The central failure mode of AI writing is therefore not ungrammatical prose, but unsupported persuasion: text that is fluent, well-structured, and citation-like, yet insufficiently grounded in evidence or scientific judgment. This issue is amplified by the productivity–quality divergence observed in recent studies: AI use can increase publication output, but AI-assisted papers with complex language may be less likely to be accepted[93]。如第一阶段 (. As in Phase 1 (创造Creation），更多的文物生产并不一定意味着更强的研究。), greater artifact production does not necessarily imply stronger research.

4.1.4 调查结果和观察结果Findings and Observations

4.2 总结和过渡：写作Summary and Transition: Writing

这一阶段将重点从生产研究成果转移到将它们组织成学术论点。This phase shifts the focus from producing research artifacts to organizing them into a scholarly argument. (论文写作Paper Writing）获取第一阶段的输出，包括想法、检索到的文献、实验、图表和表格，并将它们转换成手稿，解释所做的事情、为什么重要以及证据如何支持主张。这一阶段的进展表明，人工智能系统在协助写作工作流程方面越来越有效，从规划和起草到润色、引文支持、修订，甚至全文生成。) takes the outputs of Phase 1, including ideas, retrieved literature, experiments, figures, and tables, and converts them into a manuscript that explains what was done, why it matters, and how the evidence supports the claims. Progress in this phase shows that AI systems are increasingly effective at assisting the writing workflow, from planning and drafting to polishing, citation support, revision, and even full-paper generation.

主要的限制是流利的写作可能掩盖薄弱的推理。人工智能生成或人工智能辅助的文本可能会提高可读性和生产力，同时却无法解决更深层次的科学要求：主张是否有根据、引文是否忠实地支持它们、实验是否充分以及贡献是否以适当的细微差别进行论证。这种限制既出现在半自动写作辅助中，也出现在全自动纸张生成中。前者在保留研究人员对框架、解释和最终责任的控制时是最可信的；后者在选定的环境中越来越接近可审查的质量，但仍然在论证深度、证据严谨性和审查者预期方面存在困难。The central limitation is that fluent writing can conceal weak reasoning. AI-generated or AI-assisted text may improve readability and productivity while leaving deeper scientific requirements unresolved: whether claims are grounded, whether citations faithfully support them, whether experiments are sufficient, and whether the contribution is argued with appropriate nuance. This limitation appears both in semi-automated writing assistance and in fully automated paper generation. The former is most credible when it preserves researcher control over framing, interpretation, and final responsibility; the latter increasingly approaches reviewable quality in selected settings, but still struggles with argumentative depth, evidential rigor, and reviewer anticipation.

此阶段的输出是准备供外部审查的手稿。因此，我们接下来转向第三阶段（The output of this phase is a manuscript ready for external scrutiny. We therefore next turn to Phase 3 (验证Validation），稿件通过同行评审进行评估，并通过作者反驳进行修改。这一转变将人工智能的作用从构建证据转变为连贯的论点，以评估该论点是否合理、公平和得到充分支持。), where the manuscript is evaluated through peer review and revised through author rebuttal. This transition shifts the role of AI from structuring evidence into a coherent argument to assessing whether that argument is sound, fair, and sufficiently supported.

5 第三阶段：验证Phase 3: Validation

此阶段包含在第 2 阶段（This phase encompasses the stages through which a manuscript produced in Phase 2 (写作Writing）经过外部审查和迭代完善：同行评审和修订反驳。这些阶段共同解决了一个不同的问题) is externally scrutinized and iteratively refined: peer review and rebuttal with revision. Together, these stages address a different question from创造Creation or 写作Writing: 这个贡献是否符合该领域的认知标准？does this contribution meet the epistemic standards of the field?

验证是独特的，因为它引入了审稿人的对抗性评估，审稿人预计会发现不受支持的主张、方法论缺陷、缺少比较、写作不明确和新颖性不足。这使得第三阶段成为人工智能援助的高风险环境。自动化系统可以帮助总结手稿、起草评论、综合审稿人意见、识别弱点并支持反驳准备，但它们也有放大宽大处理、偏见、对抗性操纵和毫无根据的批评的风险。因此，核心挑战不是人工智能是否能够生成类似评论的文本，而是它是否能够在不取代独立专家判断的情况下支持公平、批判性和基于证据的评估。这两个阶段也形成了一个反馈循环：审稿人的批评Validation is distinct because it introduces adversarial evaluation by reviewers who are expected to identify unsupported claims, methodological flaws, missing comparisons, unclear writing, and insufficient novelty. This makes Phase 3 a high-stakes setting for AI assistance. Automated systems can help summarize manuscripts, draft reviews, synthesize reviewer opinions, identify weaknesses, and support rebuttal preparation, but they also risk amplifying leniency, bias, adversarial manipulation, and weakly grounded criticism. The central challenge is therefore not whether AI can produce review-like text, but whether it can support fair, critical, and evidence-grounded evaluation without replacing independent expert judgment. The two stages also form a feedback loop: reviewer critiques in (同行评审Peer Review）可能需要额外的实验) may require additional experiments in（编码和实验），修订后的数字(Coding and Experiments), revised figures in (表格和数字Tables and Figures），或手稿重写), or manuscript rewrites in (论文写作Paper Writing），同时反驳和修改), while rebuttal and revision in (反驳与修改Rebuttal and Revision）确定如何解决这些批评。) determine how those critiques are addressed.

5.1 同行评审Peer Review

同行评审是验证的门户。它评估手稿在技术上是否可靠、足够新颖、表达清晰并有适当的证据支持。现有系统涵盖自动审稿生成、元审稿起草、审稿人与论文匹配以及审稿质量评估。在这些方向上，核心限制是法学硕士通常可以提出结构化且合理的批评，但可能无法发现方法论缺陷，对弱提交的分数过高，并且仍然容易受到对抗性操纵。Peer review is the gateway to validation. It evaluates whether a manuscript is technically sound, sufficiently novel, clearly presented, and supported by appropriate evidence. Existing systems span automated review generation, meta-review drafting, reviewer–paper matching, and review quality assessment. Across these directions, the central limitation is that LLMs can often produce structured and plausible critiques, but may under-detect methodological flaws, over-score weak submissions, and remain vulnerable to adversarial manipulation.

提供了自动审查系统的全面清单A comprehensive inventory of automated review systems is provided intable˜8（附录）。(Appendix).

5.1.1 自动生成评论Automated Review Generation

自动评论生成旨在对稿件进行结构化评论，包括摘要、优点、缺点、问题和评级建议。现有的方法可以分为四大类。Automated review generation aims to produce structured critiques of manuscripts, including summaries, strengths, weaknesses, questions, and rating recommendations. Existing approaches can be grouped into four broad families.微调审稿人模型Fine-tuned reviewer models让法学硕士专注于专家评审数据，以改进领域一致性和评审格式。 DeepReviewer-specialize LLMs on expert review data to improve domain alignment and review format. DeepReviewer-1414B [268]报告了针对 GPT-o1 和 ICLR 2024 接受/拒绝预测的强劲性能，而 OpenReviewerreports strong performance against GPT-o1 and on ICLR 2024 accept/reject prediction, while OpenReviewer[75]微调 Llama-fine-tunes Llama-88乙开启B on7979K专家点评。这些系统表明，监督评论数据可以改善评论风格的生成，但接受预测仍然是评论质量的狭窄代表。K expert reviews. These systems show that supervised review data can improve review-style generation, but acceptance prediction remains a narrow proxy for review quality.

多代理审查系统Multi-agent review systems将审核分解为专门的角色。玛格decompose reviewing into specialized roles. MARG[35]使用多智能体协作为每个手稿生成多个实质性评论，即开源人工智能同行评审工具uses multi-agent collaboration to generate multiple substantive comments per manuscript, the open-source ai-peer-review tool[150]使用多个法学硕士来生成独立评论，然后进行元评论综合，以及 ScholarPeeruses multiple LLMs to produce independent reviews followed by meta-review synthesis, and ScholarPeer[55]通过文献检索和权利要求验证扩展了这一范式。这种分解很有用，因为高质量的审稿需要几个不同的操作：理解手稿、检查相关工作、评估声明、识别弱点以及产生可操作的反馈。extends this paradigm with literature search and claim verification. Such decomposition is useful because high-quality reviewing requires several distinct operations: understanding the manuscript, checking related work, evaluating claims, identifying weaknesses, and producing actionable feedback.

RL 优化的审核系统RL-optimized review systems尝试通过更明确的训练信号来提高评审质量。 REMORattempt to improve review quality through more explicit training signals. REMOR[196]通过多目标强化学习优化评论生成，而 ReviewRLoptimizes review generation with multi-objective reinforcement learning, while ReviewRL[246]将检索增强上下文与强化学习相结合，以生成更全面、更有依据的评论。combines retrieval-augmented context with RL to produce more comprehensive and grounded reviews.基于提示的系统Prompt-based systems提供更轻量级的替代方案。审稿人2provide a lighter-weight alternative. Reviewer2[45]引入了一个两阶段框架，该框架对评论方面的分布进行建模，而 ChatReviewerintroduces a two-stage framework that models the distribution of review aspects, while ChatReviewer[138]提供基于 ChatGPT 的部署工具，用于分析优势、劣势和可能的改进。总体而言，自动评论生成已变得越来越结构化，但类似评论的散文不应被误认为是可靠的验证：核心困难在于批评是否准确、经过校准并以手稿和相关文献为基础。provides a deployed ChatGPT-based tool for analyzing strengths, weaknesses, and possible improvements. Overall, automated review generation has become increasingly structured, but review-like prose should not be mistaken for reliable validation: the core difficulty is whether critiques are accurate, calibrated, and grounded in the manuscript and relevant literature.

5.1.2 元评论生成Meta-Review Generation

元评审生成将多个审稿人的意见综合为连贯的区域主席式评估。此任务与单一审稿生成不同，因为它必须比较审稿人的关注点、解决分歧、达成共识并证明最终建议的合理性。巴蒂亚Meta-review generation synthesizes multiple reviewer opinions into a coherent area-chair-style assessment. This task differs from single-review generation because it must compare reviewer concerns, resolve disagreements, identify consensus, and justify a final recommendation. Bhatia等人。et al. [66]在根据 40 篇 ICLR 论文撰写元评审草稿时评估 GPT-3.5、LLaMA-2 和 PaLM-2，发现 LLM 对于多视角总结很有用，但难以应对细致入微的判断要求。代理审查evaluate GPT-3.5, LLaMA-2, and PaLM-2 on composing meta-review drafts from 40 ICLR papers, finding that LLMs are useful for multi-perspective summarization but struggle with nuanced judgment calls. AgentReview[83]模拟完整的审查生命周期，包括元审查和最终决策，并表明社会影响和权威偏见会影响结果。simulates the full review lifecycle, including meta-review and final decisions, and shows that social influence and authority bias can affect outcomes.

主要的挑战不仅仅是总结，而是在分歧下做出决策。当审稿人对稿件的贡献存在根本分歧时，法学硕士通常会做出稀释的妥协，而不是采取可辩护的实质性立场。这种限制反映了人工智能辅助验证中更广泛的问题：当前的系统更擅长整合既定意见，而不是独立裁决技术争议。The main challenge is not summarization alone, but decision-making under disagreement. When reviewers fundamentally disagree about a manuscript’s contribution, LLMs often produce diluted compromises rather than taking a defensible substantive position. This limitation reflects a broader issue in AI-assisted validation: current systems are better at consolidating stated opinions than at independently adjudicating technical disputes.

5.1.3 审稿人匹配Reviewer Matching

审稿人-论文匹配通过将稿件分配给具有相关专业知识的审稿人同时考虑利益冲突来支持编辑过程。这项任务不如评审生成那么明显，但它对于大规模评审质量至关重要：如果评审者缺乏适当的领域专业知识，即使写得很好的评审也没什么用处。 RelevAI-审稿人Reviewer–paper matching supports the editorial process by assigning manuscripts to reviewers with relevant expertise while accounting for conflicts of interest. This task is less visible than review generation, but it is crucial for review quality at scale: even a well-written review is less useful if the reviewer lacks appropriate domain expertise. RelevAI-Reviewer[34]已在各大场馆部署，同时RATEhas been deployed at major venues, while RATE[118]通过概要蒸馏改进基于专业知识的匹配，旨在捕获审稿人超越关键字重叠的能力签名。improves expertise-based matching through profile distillation, aiming to capture a reviewer’s competence signature beyond keyword overlap.

与自动审稿相比，审稿人匹配是更适合运营人工智能支持的设置，因为它有助于分配过程而不是取代专家判断。然而，匹配系统仍然需要透明的冲突处理、强大的专业知识建模和人工监督，特别是在表面关键词相似性可能会产生误导的跨学科领域。Compared with automated reviewing, reviewer matching is a more appropriate setting for operational AI support because it assists the allocation process rather than replacing expert judgment. However, matching systems still require transparent conflict handling, robust expertise modeling, and human oversight, especially in interdisciplinary areas where surface-level keyword similarity can be misleading.

评估人工智能辅助同行评审需要的不仅仅是衡量生成的评审是否类似于人类评审。有用的审查必须是一致的、批判性的、公平的、有根据的、并且不易被操纵。在一致性方面，最近的系统显示出可衡量的进步。斯坦福代理评论家Assessing AI-assisted peer review requires more than measuring whether generated reviews resemble human reviews. Zhou等人。et al. [265]进一步证明纸面提示注入可以在静态和迭代攻击下提高 LLM 分数。在词汇层面上，雷娜further demonstrate that in-paper prompt injection can raise LLM scores under static and iterative attacks. At the lexical level, Raina等人。et al. [157]表明良性形容词可以充当对抗性触发器，而 Sahooshow that benign adjectives can function as adversarial triggers, while Sahoo等人。et al. [166]评估跨多个法学硕士和攻击策略的间接操纵，前沿模型开始在某些情况下表现出更强的抵抗力。最后，基于检测的政策执行仍然脆弱：萨哈evaluate indirect manipulation across multiple LLMs and attack strategies, with frontier models beginning to show stronger resistance in some settings. 5.1.5 调查结果和观察结果Findings and Observations

5.2 反驳与修改Rebuttal and Revision

反驳和修改构成第三阶段的第二阶段（Rebuttal and revision form the second stage of Phase 3 (验证Validation），作者回应外部批评并在做出最终决定或准备上镜提交之前修改稿件。这个阶段在认识论上很重要，因为这是出版过程中作者直接参与审稿人反对意见的唯一阶段。现有工作涵盖审稿人评论分析、自动反驳生成和修订跟踪。在这些方向上，核心挑战不仅仅是产生有说服力的回应，而是确保反驳有证据依据、忠实于手稿，并随后进行实际修改。), where authors respond to external critique and revise the manuscript before a final decision or camera-ready submission. This stage is epistemologically important because it is the only point in the publication process where authors engage directly with reviewers’ objections. Existing work spans reviewer-comment analysis, automated rebuttal generation, and revision tracking. Across these directions, the central challenge is not merely generating persuasive responses, but ensuring that rebuttals are evidence-grounded, faithful to the manuscript, and followed by actual revisions.

5.2.1 审稿人评论分析Reviewer Comment Analysis

审稿人评论分析将批评分解为可采取行动的问题，例如实验缺失、动机不明确、基线不足、主张不受支持或演示问题。这种分析是有效反驳生成的先决条件，因为审稿人的评论通常很长，优先级混合，并且审稿之间部分重叠。回顾MTReviewer-comment analysis decomposes critiques into actionable concerns, such as missing experiments, unclear motivation, insufficient baselines, unsupported claims, or presentation issues. This analysis is a prerequisite for effective rebuttal generation because reviewer comments are often long, mixed in priority, and partially overlapping across reviews. ReviewMT[197]将同行评审建模为具有基于角色的互动的多回合、长上下文对话，涵盖models peer review as multi-turn, long-context dialogue with role-based interactions, covering26,84126{,}841论文和papers and92,01792{,}017ICLR 和 Nature Communications 的评论。重新reviews from ICLR and Nature Communications. Re2 [249]进一步提供了一个确保一致性的数据集，用于全阶段同行评审和多轮反驳，涵盖further provides a consistency-ensured dataset for full-stage peer review and multi-turn rebuttal, covering19,92619{,}926提交的材料，submissions,70,66870{,}668评论，以及reviews, and53,81853{,}818来自24个会议的反驳。rebuttals from 24 conferences.

实证研究表明，反驳会对结果产生重大影响，尤其是对于边缘提交的材料。 ICLR 2024-2025 分析Empirical studies show that rebuttal can materially affect outcomes, especially for borderline submissions. Analysis of ICLR 2024–2025[86]报道称reports that7575–81%81\%反驳后分数保持不变，of scores remain unchanged after rebuttal,1717–23%23\%改善，并且仅大约improve, and only approximately1%1\%减少，最常见的转变是decrease, with the most common transition being5→65\rightarrow 6从边界到可以接受。这些数字表明反驳并不是一种普遍的补救措施，但对于审稿人的担忧可以得到澄清、纠正或用额外证据支持的论文子集来说，反驳是重要的。from borderline to acceptable. These numbers suggest that rebuttal is not a universal remedy, but it is consequential for the subset of papers where reviewer concerns can be clarified, corrected, or supported with additional evidence.

5.2.2 自动反驳生成Automated Rebuttal Generation

自动反驳生成试图产生作者的回复，以明确和战略性地解决审稿人的担忧。早期的系统将反驳视为直接文本生成，但这种表述很容易产生幻觉、错过审稿人观点和无法验证的主张。因此，更新的系统将反驳分解为中间步骤，例如关注点提取、证据检索、响应计划和最终生成。Automated rebuttal generation attempts to produce author responses that address reviewer concerns clearly and strategically. Early systems treated rebuttal as direct text generation, but this formulation is prone to hallucination, missed reviewer points, and unverifiable claims. More recent systems therefore decompose rebuttal into intermediate steps such as concern extraction, evidence retrieval, response planning, and final generation.

反驳代理RebuttalAgent[63]使用心理理论模型来制定有策略性的有说服力的回应，报告平均水平uses Theory-of-Mind modeling to craft strategically persuasive responses, reporting an average18.3%18.3\%对基本模型的改进。论文2反驳improvement over the base model. Paper2Rebuttal[129]通过将审稿人评论分解为原子关注点并检索支持文献，引入以证据为中心的计划，将覆盖率和特异性提高最多introduces evidence-centric planning by decomposing reviewer comments into atomic concerns and retrieving supporting literature, improving Coverage and Specificity by up to+0.78+0.78和and+1.33+1.33。也是审稿人. ReviewerToo[167]在更广泛的模块化框架和报告中包括反驳模块includes a rebuttal module within a broader modular framework and reports81.8%81.8\%接受/拒绝准确性。accept/reject accuracy.

一个新的方向强调规划和作者控制。角色扮演游戏A newer direction emphasizes planning and author control. DRPG[60]提出了一个四步分解-检索-计划-生成管道，报告proposes a four-step Decompose–Retrieve–Plan–Generate pipeline, reporting98%98\%+ 计划准确性和强于平均水平的人类反驳质量+ planning accuracy and stronger-than-average human rebuttal quality with an88B型。作者在环B model. Author-in-the-Loop[163]将作者的专业知识和意图融入到回复生成中，旨在确保反驳反映论文的实际贡献，而不是通用的法学硕士输出。这些系统表明反驳自动化正在从流畅的响应生成转向基于证据和作者意识的修订支持。integrates author expertise and intent into response generation, aiming to ensure that rebuttals reflect the paper’s actual contributions rather than generic LLM output. These systems indicate that rebuttal automation is moving from fluent response generation toward evidence-grounded and author-aware revision support.

5.2.3 评估：反驳有效性Assessment: Rebuttal Effectiveness

评估反驳系统需要衡量直接有效性和下游责任。即时有效性关系到反驳是否能解决审稿人的担忧、澄清误解、提供证据并提高审稿人的信心。 ICLR 2024-2025 分析显示，经过反驳后分数提高的论文的接受率达到Assessing rebuttal systems requires measuring both immediate effectiveness and downstream accountability. Immediate effectiveness concerns whether a rebuttal addresses reviewer concerns, clarifies misunderstandings, provides evidence, and improves reviewer confidence. ICLR 2024–2025 analysis shows that papers whose scores improve after rebuttal achieve acceptance rates of55.755.7–57.6%57.6\%，相比, compared to7.87.8–12.4%12.4\%对于分数不变的论文for papers with unchanged scores[86]。这使得反驳对于边缘论文尤其重要，审稿人信心的微小变化可能会影响最终结果。. This makes rebuttal especially important for borderline papers, where small changes in reviewer confidence can affect final outcomes.

然而，有效的反驳不仅仅是说服。许多审稿人要求需要新的实验、额外的消融、更正的数字或重构手稿，从而创建一个反馈循环However, effective rebuttal is not only persuasion. Many reviewer requests require new experiments, additional ablations, corrected figures, or manuscript restructuring, creating a feedback loop from回到back to, , 和, and。阮和古列维奇. Ruan and Gurevych[163]提供大规模一致的评审-响应-修订三元组，从而能够研究反驳如何转化为实际的手稿更改。当前的反驳系统可以检索证据并起草回复，但它们通常无法根据审稿人的请求生成新的实验证据。这使得反驳实验循环成为当前自动研究管道中最实际重要的差距之一。provide large-scale aligned review–response–revision triplets, enabling the study of how rebuttals translate into actual manuscript changes. Current rebuttal systems can retrieve evidence and draft responses, but they generally cannot generate new experimental evidence in response to reviewer requests. This makes the rebuttal–experiment loop one of the most practically important gaps in current auto-research pipelines.

第二个评估维度是问责制。最近的审计The second evaluation dimension is accountability. A recent audit[21]发现 ICLR 2025 作者的平均收入为finds that ICLR 2025 authors make an average of11.811.8反驳期间每篇论文的承诺，但大约commitments per paper during rebuttal, but approximately25%25\%其中一些承诺在相机就绪版本中并未兑现，其中最常见的未兑现承诺中缺少实验。这一差距暴露了整个调查中观察到的能力与诚信之间的紧张关系：人工智能系统可能会产生看似合理且有说服力的回应，但反驳的科学有效性取决于其主张是否得到支持以及其承诺是否随后得到落实。因此，反驳系统不仅应根据回复质量进行评估，还应根据关注范围、证据基础、修订可追溯性和作者承诺的履行情况进行评估。of these commitments are not fulfilled in the camera-ready version, with missing experiments among the most common unfulfilled promises. This gap exposes the same capability-versus-integrity tension observed throughout the survey: AI systems may generate plausible and persuasive responses, but the scientific validity of a rebuttal depends on whether its claims are supported and its promises are later implemented. Rebuttal systems should therefore be evaluated not only by response quality, but also by concern coverage, evidence grounding, revision traceability, and fulfillment of author commitments.

5.2.4 调查结果和观察结果Findings and Observations

5.3 总结和过渡：验证Summary and Transition: Validation

这一阶段将重点从构建手稿转移到测试其主张是否经得起外部审查。This phase shifts the focus from constructing a manuscript to testing whether its claims withstand external scrutiny. (同行评审Peer Review）通过独立评论评估手稿，同时) evaluates the manuscript through independent critique, while (反驳与修改Rebuttal and Revision）为作者提供了澄清、辩护和修改作品的机会。这些阶段共同形成一个反馈循环，而不是单向检查点：审稿人的评论可以触发新的实验、修改的分析、更新的数据和大量的手稿重写。) gives authors an opportunity to clarify, defend, and revise the work in response. Together, these stages form a feedback loop rather than a one-way checkpoint: reviewer comments can trigger new experiments, revised analyses, updated figures, and substantial manuscript rewriting.

验证的进展显示出一致的模式。人工智能系统越来越有能力产生类似评论的评论、总结审稿人的意见、支持审稿人匹配以及起草反驳回复。然而，验证的难点不是生成可信的评估文本；而是生成可信的评估文本。它正在做出公正、批判性、基于证据的判断，并确保批评导致负责任的修订。在同行评审中，独立的人工智能评审者可能是一致的，但宽松、有偏见或容易受到操纵，而最强大的经过验证的部署模式是使用人工智能来改进人类评审。反驳说，人工智能可以帮助分解担忧并起草有证据意识的回应，但尚无法生成缺失的实验证据或保证作者的承诺得到履行。Progress in Validation shows a consistent pattern. AI systems are increasingly capable of producing review-like critiques, summarizing reviewer opinions, supporting reviewer matching, and drafting rebuttal responses. However, the hard part of validation is not producing plausible evaluative text; it is making fair, critical, evidence-grounded judgments and ensuring that critique leads to accountable revision. In peer review, standalone AI reviewers may be consistent but lenient, biased, or vulnerable to manipulation, while the strongest validated deployment mode is to use AI to improve human reviews. In rebuttal, AI can help decompose concerns and draft evidence-aware responses, but cannot yet generate missing experimental evidence or guarantee that author commitments are fulfilled.

这一阶段的输出是一份经过外部挑战、辩护和修改的手稿。一旦得到验证，研究必须在审查过程之外通过海报、幻灯片、视频、项目页面和社交媒体进行交流。因此，我们接下来转向第四阶段（The output of this phase is a manuscript that has been externally challenged, defended, and revised. Once validated, the research must be communicated beyond the review process through posters, slides, videos, project pages, and social media. We therefore next turn to Phase 4 (传播Dissemination），人工智能协助从评估学术主张转向针对不同受众、格式和传播目标调整经过验证的研究成果。), where AI assistance shifts from evaluating scholarly claims to adapting validated research artifacts for different audiences, formats, and communication goals.

6 第四阶段：传播Phase 4: Dissemination

此阶段将经过验证的手稿转换为专业场地读者之外的受众可以访问的格式。讨论涵盖将论文转化为海报、幻灯片、视频、社交媒体帖子和互动代理。与早期阶段相比，传播与其说是产生或验证科学主张，不如说是使这些主张适应不同的受众、媒体和互动模式。This phase converts the validated manuscript into formats accessible to audiences beyond specialist venue readers. The discussion covers the transformation of papers into posters, slides, videos, social media posts, and interactive agents. Compared with earlier phases, Dissemination is less about producing or validating scientific claims than about adapting those claims to different audiences, media, and interaction modes.

传播值得一个单独的阶段，因为它的输出是独立的知识工件，而不是论文的简单衍生品。海报必须将贡献压缩成单一的视觉叙事；幻灯片必须支持口头解释；视频必须同步视觉、文本和语音通道；社交媒体帖子必须平衡可访问性和精确性；交互代理必须公开论文的方法以供下游使用。因此，核心挑战不是人工智能是否可以重新格式化论文，而是它能否在保持科学保真度的同时使论文适应新的模式、受众和互动水平。Dissemination merits a separate phase because its outputs are independent knowledge artifacts rather than simple derivatives of the paper. A poster must compress the contribution into a single visual narrative; a slide deck must support oral explanation; a video must synchronize visual, textual, and spoken channels; a social media post must balance accessibility with precision; and an interactive agent must expose the paper’s methods for downstream use. The central challenge is therefore not whether AI can reformat a paper, but whether it can preserve scientific fidelity while adapting the work to new modalities, audiences, and levels of interactivity.

6.1 研究传播（Paper2X）Research Dissemination (Paper2X)

研究传播将完成的论文转化为适合受众的工件。与主要针对专业作者、审稿人和读者的阶段 1-3 不同，Paper2X 的输出必须服务于不同的受众：与会者、口头会议受众、在线读者、潜在用户、记者、从业者和未来的研究人员，他们可能通过工具而不是文本与工作进行交互。现有系统涵盖海报生成、幻灯片生成、旁白视频和谈话生成、社交媒体和网页生成以及新兴的纸张到代理的转换。在这些格式中，核心瓶颈是信任：研究人员可以使用人工智能起草面向公众的材料，但他们仍然不愿意将最终的沟通委托给可能扭曲结果、夸大主张或忽略重要限制的系统。Research dissemination converts a completed paper into audience-adaptive artifacts. Unlike Phases 1–3, which primarily target specialist authors, reviewers, and readers, Paper2X outputs must serve diverse audiences: conference attendees, oral-session audiences, online readers, prospective users, journalists, practitioners, and future researchers who may interact with the work through tools rather than text. Existing systems cover poster generation, slide generation, narrated video and talk generation, social media and web-page generation, and emerging paper-to-agent conversion. Across these formats, the core bottleneck is trust: researchers may use AI to draft public-facing materials, but they remain reluctant to delegate final communication to systems that may distort results, overstate claims, or omit important limitations.

提供了跨海报、幻灯片、视频、网络、社交媒体和代理格式的 Paper2X 系统的全面清单A comprehensive inventory of Paper2X systems across poster, slides, video, web, social media, and agentic formats is provided intable˜10（附录）。(Appendix).

6.1.1 纸张到海报Paper to Posters

从纸张到海报的生成将完整的手稿转变为紧凑的视觉叙述。这需要的不仅仅是总结：系统必须选择中心信息，在动机、方法、结果和结论之间分配空间，保留关键数字和表格，并将它们排列成可读的布局。与幻灯片生成相比，海报生成具有更强的空间限制，因为所有内容都必须在单个画布上清晰且连贯。Paper-to-poster generation transforms a full manuscript into a compact visual narrative. This requires more than summarization: the system must select the central message, allocate space across motivation, method, results, and conclusion, preserve key figures and tables, and arrange them into a readable layout. Compared with slide generation, poster generation has stronger spatial constraints because all content must be legible and coherent on a single canvas.

早期系统将代理海报生成作为一项可行的任务。纸2海报Early systems established agentic poster generation as a feasible task. Paper2Poster[146]引入了具有二叉树布局规划和画家-评论者反馈循环的 PosterAgent，表明海报生成可以分解为布局构建、渲染和评论。后续系统增加了更强的设计和层次意识。海报生成器introduces PosterAgent with binary-tree layout planning and a Painter–Commenter feedback loop, showing that poster generation can be decomposed into layout construction, rendering, and critique. Subsequent systems add stronger design and hierarchy awareness. PosterGen[256]融合了具有审美意识的多智能体生成，PosterForestincorporates aesthetic-aware multi-agent generation, PosterForest[33]采用分层多智能体协作，P2Puses hierarchical multi-agent collaboration, and P2P[194]引入了 P2PInstruct 以及用于海报设计的专门代理和指令数据。introduces P2PInstruct with specialized agents and instruction data for poster design.

最近的系统从一次性海报创建转向编辑和统一海报操作。尖峰Recent systems move from one-shot poster creation toward editing and unified poster manipulation. APEX[180]支持精细化控制的交互式海报编辑，满足会议筹备过程中人工后期编辑的实际需求。海报全能supports interactive poster editing with fine-grained control, addressing the practical need for human post-editing in conference preparation.
