PosterOmni[27]统一了多种海报任务，包括重新缩放、填充、扩展、布局驱动生成、风格驱动生成和身份驱动生成，而 PosterCraftunifies multiple poster tasks, including rescaling, filling, extension, layout-driven generation, style-driven generation, and identity-driven generation, while PosterCraft[28]进一步探索统一框架中的质量意识海报生成。这些系统共同表明海报自动化正在从直接的论文摘要转向可编辑、具有设计意识的海报制作。further explores quality-aware poster generation in a unified framework. Together, these systems suggest that poster automation is shifting from direct paper summarization toward editable, design-aware poster production.

6.1.2 纸张到幻灯片Paper to Slides

纸张到幻灯片系统将手稿转换为用于口头演示的连续视觉叙述。与海报不同，幻灯片会随着时间的推移展开，并且必须支持演讲者的演讲。这需要内容选择、章节到幻灯片映射、视觉布局、演讲者笔记合成，以及基于渲染幻灯片质量的迭代细化。关键的挑战是保留论文的论点，同时将其修辞结构从书面阐述改为口头解释。Paper-to-slides systems convert manuscripts into sequential visual narratives for oral presentation. Unlike posters, slides unfold over time and must support speaker delivery. This requires content selection, section-to-slide mapping, visual layout, speaker-note synthesis, and often iterative refinement based on rendered slide quality. The key challenge is preserving the paper’s argument while changing its rhetorical structure from written exposition to spoken explanation.

早期的数据集和管道确立了这项任务。文档2PPTEarly datasets and pipelines established the task. DOC2PPT[41]提供配对的文档幻灯片数据，而 PPTAgentprovides paired document–slide data, while PPTAgent[261]使用 PPTEval 生成和评估内容、设计和连贯性的演示文稿。然后，基于环境的细化缩小了符号规划和渲染幻灯片之间的差距。深度演示者generates and evaluates presentations with PPTEval across content, design, and coherence. Environment-grounded refinement then closes the gap between symbolic planning and rendered slides. DeepPresenter[262]对渲染的幻灯片图像进行条件修正，而不仅仅是内部推理痕迹，这表明视觉反馈对于演示质量很重要。conditions revision on rendered slide images rather than only internal reasoning traces, showing that visual feedback is important for presentation quality.

多代理和交互系统进一步将幻灯片生成分解为专门的子任务。幻灯片生成器Multi-agent and interactive systems further decompose slide generation into specialized subtasks. SlideGen[111]使用代理进行大纲、内容映射、排列、笔记合成和迭代细化，以生成可编辑的 PPTX 幻灯片。自动幻灯片uses agents for outlining, content mapping, arrangement, note synthesis, and iterative refinement to produce editable PPTX slides. Auto-Slides[234]目标是通过多代理协作和交互式编辑生成 Beamer。幻灯片裁缝targets Beamer generation with multi-agent collaboration and interactive editing. SlideTailor[247]使用语音链机制从单个示例对生成用户偏好的条件。其他系统专注于特定于任务的功能：PASSconditions generation on user preference from a single example pair using a chain-of-speech mechanism. Other systems focus on task-specific capabilities: PASS[3]将幻灯片生成与 AI 音频传输、AutoPresent 相结合combines slide generation with AI audio delivery, AutoPresent[48]在 SlidesBench、Paper2Slides 上微调幻灯片生成模型fine-tunes a slide-generation model on SlidesBench, Paper2Slides[64]通过多级 RAG 管道提供一键转换，与您的幻灯片对话provides one-click conversion through a multi-stage RAG pipeline, Talk to Your Slides[84]支持自然语言幻灯片编辑和Office Raccoonsupports natural-language slide editing, and Office Raccoon[173]目标是通过模板和品牌指南学习进行页面级编辑。在这些系统中，主要趋势是从静态幻灯片生成转向可编辑、反馈感知和用户偏好条件的演示设计。targets page-level editing with template and brand-guideline learning. Across these systems, the main trend is from static slide generation toward editable, feedback-aware, and user-preference-conditioned presentation design.

6.1.3 论文到视频和演讲Paper to Videos and Talks

纸到视频和纸到谈话系统将传播从视觉制品扩展到多模态解释。这些系统必须协调幻灯片、字幕、旁白、光标运动、节奏，有时还协调头像或头像视频。这使得该任务比海报或幻灯片生成困难得多：错误不仅可能来自内容选择，还可能来自时间对齐、语音清晰度、视觉同步和持续时间限制。Paper-to-video and paper-to-talk systems extend dissemination from visual artifacts to multimodal explanation. These systems must coordinate slides, subtitles, narration, cursor motion, pacing, and sometimes avatar or talking-head video. This makes the task substantially harder than poster or slide generation: errors can arise not only from content selection, but also from temporal alignment, speech clarity, visual synchronization, and duration constraints.

当前代理PresentAgent[181]提供端到端文档到叙述视频管道，具有同步幻灯片、文本到语音叙述和 PresentEval 基准。纸2视频provides an end-to-end document-to-narrated-video pipeline with synchronized slides, text-to-speech narration, and the PresentEval benchmark. Paper2Video[270]引入了纸质视频对的基准和 PaperTalker 框架，将视频生成分解为幻灯片、字幕、光标和演讲者构建器。传教士introduces a benchmark of paper–video pairs and the PaperTalker framework, decomposing video generation into slide, subtitle, cursor, and talker builders. Preacher[116]使用自上而下的分解，然后自下而上的生成，以及跨多个研究领域的渐进式思想链。uses top-down decomposition followed by bottom-up generation with Progressive Chain of Thought across multiple research fields.

尽管这些系统显示出可喜的进展，但视频仍然是最难的 Paper2X 格式之一。与海报和幻灯片不同，视频生成需要至少四种模式的协调：视觉幻灯片、字幕、语音音频以及基于时间或头像的演示。由此产生的工件还必须忠实于论文，同时足够简洁以便观众能够理解。因此，当前的系统最适合作为初稿生成器，生成供人工审核的同步演示资源，而不是不需要编辑的最终面向公众的视频。Although these systems show promising progress, video remains one of the hardest Paper2X formats. Unlike posters and slides, video generation requires coordination across at least four modalities: visual slides, subtitles, speech audio, and temporal or avatar-based presentation. The resulting artifact must also remain faithful to the paper while being concise enough for viewers to follow. Current systems, therefore, work best as first-draft generators that produce synchronized presentation assets for human review, rather than final public-facing videos requiring no editing.

6.1.4 纸质到社交媒体Paper to Social Media

纸质到社交媒体和纸质到网络的生成旨在使研究成果在出版场所之外也能被发现。输出包括项目页面、博客文章、新闻稿式摘要、简短的研究文章和 X/Twitter 线程。这些格式需要比海报或幻灯片更强大的受众建模：机器学习从业者的主题、记者的简明摘要以及潜在用户的项目页面介绍应该强调不同的细节，使用不同的词汇，并对背景知识做出不同的假设。Paper-to-social-media and paper-to-web generation aims to make research discoverable outside the publication venue. Outputs include project pages, blog posts, press-release-style summaries, short-form research posts, and X/Twitter threads. These formats require stronger audience modeling than posters or slides: a thread for ML practitioners, a lay summary for journalists, and a project-page introduction for potential users should emphasize different details, use different vocabulary, and make different assumptions about background knowledge.

纸到网络Paper2Web[30]将论文转换为富含多媒体的交互式学术主页，并为此任务提供基准。更普遍的是，研究人员越来越多地使用通用法学硕士来起草在线摘要、图形标题、项目页面文本和社交媒体公告。然而，专门针对社交媒体的研究工具仍然相对不发达。瓶颈不仅仅在于文本生成，还在于受众适应性的保真度：系统必须简化而不扭曲，强调贡献而不夸大，并在保持吸引力的同时保留限制。converts papers into interactive multimedia-rich academic homepages and provides a benchmark for this task. More generally, researchers increasingly use general-purpose LLMs to draft online summaries, figure captions, project-page text, and social media announcements. However, dedicated research-to-social-media tools remain comparatively underdeveloped. The bottleneck is not text generation alone, but audience-adaptive fidelity: systems must simplify without distorting, emphasize contributions without exaggeration, and preserve limitations while remaining engaging.

这使得社会传播成为一个明显的信任问题。面向公众的成果通常是在没有论文的情况下阅读的，因此任何夸大其词、遗漏警告或误导性比较都可能影响人们对作品的看法。因此，当人工智能提供针对特定受众的草稿、风格变体和声明检查支持，同时将最终消息传递和事实责任留给作者时，人工智能援助是最可信的。This makes social dissemination a distinct trust problem. Public-facing outputs are often read without the paper, so any overclaim, missing caveat, or misleading comparison can shape how the work is perceived. AI assistance is therefore most credible when it provides audience-specific drafts, style variants, and claim-checking support, while leaving final messaging and factual responsibility to the authors.

6.1.5 论文给代理和工具Paper to Agents and Tools

更新的传播方向将论文从静态文档转换为交互式代理或工具。这改变了传播的功能：系统不再仅仅解释贡献，而是通过自然语言交互公开论文的方法、代码、数据或工作流程。在这种设置下，读者成为可以查询、复制、改编或扩展作品的用户。A newer dissemination direction converts papers from static documents into interactive agents or tools. This changes the function of dissemination: instead of only explaining a contribution, the system exposes the paper’s methods, code, data, or workflows through natural-language interaction. In this setting, the reader becomes a user who can query, reproduce, adapt, or extend the work.

Paper2Agent [132]通过将研究论文和相关代码库转换为交互式论文代理来例证这种转变。该系统分析论文和代码，使用工具、资源和提示构建模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器，并迭代测试生成的代理，以便用户可以通过自然语言与论文的方法进行交互。这将传播重新定义为操作访问：论文不再只是被阅读，而是被查询和执行。exemplifies this shift by converting research papers and associated codebases into interactive paper agents. The system analyzes the paper and code, constructs a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with tools, resources, and prompts, and iteratively tests the resulting agent so that users can interact with the paper’s methods through natural language. This reframes dissemination as operational access: a paper is no longer only read, but queried and executed.

相关系统将这一想法从特定于纸张的代理扩展到使用工具的科学代理。高Related systems broaden this idea from paper-specific agents to tool-using scientific agents. Gao等人。et al. [42]研究科学工具生态系统如何通过代理可访问的界面公开计算能力，从而使人工智能科学家民主化。蛋白MCPstudy how scientific tool ecosystems can democratize AI scientists by exposing computational capabilities through agent-accessible interfaces. ProteinMCP[227]将基于 MCP 的代理框架应用于蛋白质工程，说明如何将特定领域的工作流程包装到交互式工具使用系统中。这些系统表明，未来的传播可能会越来越多地涉及可执行接口、可重复的工作流程和领域代理，使研究更容易重用。applies an MCP-based agentic framework to protein engineering, illustrating how domain-specific workflows can be wrapped into interactive, tool-using systems. These systems suggest that future dissemination may increasingly involve executable interfaces, reproducible workflows, and domain agents that make research easier to reuse.

这个方向也带来了新的风险。交互式论文代理不仅必须忠实地总结论文，而且必须正确使用工具，尊重原始方法的局限性，并避免将不受支持的外推作为有效的结论。因此，评估需要沟通指标和再现性指标：代理是否清楚地解释了论文，是否调用了正确的工具，是否再现了预期结果，以及是否负责任地处理超出范围的用户查询。This direction also introduces new risks. An interactive paper agent must not only summarize the paper faithfully, but also execute tools correctly, respect the limitations of the original method, and avoid presenting unsupported extrapolations as valid conclusions. Evaluation therefore requires both communication metrics and reproducibility metrics: whether the agent explains the paper clearly, whether it invokes the correct tools, whether it reproduces expected results, and whether it handles out-of-scope user queries responsibly.

6.1.6 评估：保真度、可用性和采用度Assessment: Fidelity, Usability, and Adoption

Paper2X 的评估必须评估三个维度：Assessment for Paper2X must evaluate three dimensions:保真度fidelity，生成的工件是否准确地代表了论文；, whether the generated artifact accurately represents the paper;可用性usability，工件是否支持其预期的通信或交互目标；和, whether the artifact supports its intended communication or interaction goal; and收养adoption，研究人员是否足够信任该工件以公开使用它。保真度是最重要的维度，因为传播工件通常独立于论文而传播。精美的海报、幻灯片、视频或线索如果省略警告、更改基线、错误地简化方法或夸大结果，则可能会歪曲贡献。, whether researchers trust the artifact enough to use it publicly. Fidelity is the most important dimension because dissemination artifacts often circulate independently of the paper. A polished poster, slide, video, or thread can misrepresent a contribution if it omits caveats, changes baselines, simplifies methods incorrectly, or exaggerates results.

海报和幻灯片生成拥有最成熟的评估基础设施。纸2海报Poster and slide generation have the most mature evaluation infrastructure. Paper2Poster[146]在具有成本效益的生成设置下评估海报质量，而 PPTAgentevaluates poster quality under cost-efficient generation settings, while PPTAgent[261]引入 PPTEval 来根据内容、设计和连贯性维度评估幻灯片质量。视频评估较新：PresentEvalintroduces PPTEval to assess slide quality along content, design, and coherence dimensions. Video evaluation is newer: PresentEval[181]评估叙述视频管道和 Paper2Videoevaluates narrated video pipelines, and Paper2Video[270]通过纸质视频对引入面向理解的评估。这些基准反映了从表面美学到生成的材料是否保留内容并提高观众理解的更广泛的转变。introduces comprehension-oriented evaluation through paper–video pairs. These benchmarks reflect a broader shift from surface aesthetics toward whether generated materials preserve content and improve audience understanding.

代理传播需要额外的评估标准。评估纸质代理不仅应该通过答案质量，还应该通过工具的正确性、可重复性、错误处理和边界意识。这使得Paper2X评估更接近编码和实验中的评估问题（Agentic dissemination requires additional evaluation criteria. A paper agent should be assessed not only by answer quality, but also by tool correctness, reproducibility, error handling, and boundary awareness. This makes Paper2X evaluation closer to the assessment problems in Coding and Experiments ()：系统在调用错误的工作流程或返回不受支持的输出时，在自然语言中可能会显得很有帮助。就各种格式而言，尚未有大规模采用研究确定与作者手动创建的材料相比，Paper2X 工具是否会减少或增加虚假陈述。因此，Paper2X 系统目前最好被理解为绘图和交互辅助工具，而不是最终生产者。): a system may appear helpful in natural language while invoking the wrong workflow or returning unsupported outputs. Across formats, no large-scale adoption study has yet established whether Paper2X tools reduce or increase misrepresentation compared with manual author-created materials. As a result, Paper2X systems are currently best understood as drafting and interaction aids rather than final producers.

6.1.7 调查结果和观察结果Findings and Observations

6.2 摘要和过渡：传播Summary and Transition: Dissemination

这一阶段将重点从经过验证的学术论点转移到适合受众的沟通和重用上。目标是将手稿转换为海报、幻灯片、视频、项目页面、社交媒体帖子以及日益互动的代理或工具。这一阶段的进展表明，人工智能可以大大降低制作传播工件的成本，特别是当输入论文完整并且目标格式具有可预测的结构时。This phase shifts the focus from validated scholarly argument to audience-adaptive communication and reuse. The goal is to convert the manuscript into posters, slides, videos, project pages, social media posts, and increasingly interactive agents or tools. Progress in this phase shows that AI can substantially lower the cost of producing dissemination artifacts, especially when the input paper is complete and the target format has a predictable structure.

主要限制是格式变化下的保真度。每个传播工件都会压缩、重新排序或重新表达论文，从而为遗漏、夸大或扭曲创造机会。这种风险在不同格式中表现得有所不同：海报和幻灯片可能会过度简化贡献，视频可能会导致叙述和视觉证据不一致，社交媒体帖子可能会以细微差别换取参与度，纸质代理可能会暴露超出其验证范围的工具或工作流程。因此，当传播阶段的自动化支持草稿生成、格式调整、编辑和交互，同时保留作者对声明和限制的监督时，它是最可信的。The central limitation is fidelity under format change. Each dissemination artifact compresses, reorders, or re-expresses the paper, creating opportunities for omission, overstatement, or distortion. This risk appears differently across formats: posters and slides may oversimplify the contribution, videos may misalign narration and visual evidence, social media posts may trade nuance for engagement, and paper agents may expose tools or workflows beyond their validated scope. Dissemination-stage automation is therefore most credible when it supports draft generation, format adaptation, editing, and interaction while preserving author oversight over claims and limitations.

此阶段的完成结束了研究生命周期：贡献已被创建、编写、验证和传达。剩下的问题是什么模式贯穿所有阶段。因此，我们接下来综合了定义人工智能辅助研究的通用架构、能力边界、部署原则和开放挑战。The completion of this phase closes the research lifecycle: a contribution has been created, written, validated, and communicated. The remaining question is what patterns cut across all phases. We therefore next synthesize the common architectures, capability boundaries, deployment principles, and open challenges that define AI-assisted research as a whole.

7 横切分析Cross-Cutting Analysis

前面几节对人工智能辅助研究进行了阶段性分析。我们现在综合整个生命周期中出现的模式。这种跨领域的观点是必要的，因为许多最重要的限制不会出现在单个阶段内，而是出现在阶段之间的边界上：实施后削弱的想法、以书面形式歪曲的检索证据、产生不受支持的主张的实验、遗漏方法论缺陷的评论、承诺修订但未实现修订的反驳，以及简化证据之外的结果的传播工件。The preceding sections analyzed AI-assisted research stage by stage. We now synthesize patterns that emerge across the complete lifecycle. This cross-cutting view is necessary because many of the most important limitations do not appear within a single stage, but at the boundaries between stages: ideas that weaken after implementation, retrieved evidence that is misrepresented in writing, experiments that produce unsupported claims, reviews that miss methodological flaws, rebuttals that promise revisions without fulfilling them, and dissemination artifacts that simplify results beyond the evidence.

我们围绕以下内容组织此分析We organize this analysis around四four问题。首先，端到端系统如何整合研究生命周期的多个阶段？其次，应该如何跨异构工件和长期工作流程评估研究自动化？第三，跨阶段出现哪些重复的能力边界和部署原则？最后，在人工智能系统被信任为可靠的研究合作者而不是工件生成器之前，必须解决哪些公开的挑战？questions. First, how do end-to-end systems integrate multiple stages of the research lifecycle? Second, how should research automation be evaluated across heterogeneous artifacts and long-horizon workflows? Third, what recurring capability boundaries and deployment principles appear across phases? Finally, what open challenges must be addressed before AI systems can be trusted as reliable research collaborators rather than artifact generators?

7.1 端到端研究系统End-to-End Research Systems

前面讨论过的一些系统，尤其是Some systems discussed earlier, especially insection˜4，也有资格成为端到端研究系统，因为它们生成完整的手稿。然而，在这里，我们从不同的角度来分析它们：不是作为论文写作工具，而是作为生命周期规模的架构。关键问题是这些系统如何连接构思、文献综述、编码、实验、写作、验证和传播，以及阶段之间的切换仍然脆弱。, also qualify as end-to-end research systems because they generate complete manuscripts. Here, however, we analyze them from a different perspective: not as paper-writing tools, but as lifecycle-scale architectures. The key question is how these systems connect ideation, literature review, coding, experimentation, writing, validation, and dissemination, and where the handoffs between stages remain fragile.

当前大多数端到端系统都强调第一阶段（Most current end-to-end systems emphasize Phase 1 (创造Creation）和第 2 阶段（) and Phase 2 (写作Writing），将想法产生、实施、实验执行和手稿起草连接到一个工作流程中。纳入实质性第三阶段的系统要少得多（), connecting idea generation, implementation, experiment execution, and manuscript drafting into a single workflow. Far fewer systems incorporate substantive Phase 3 (验证Validation），例如对抗性审查、反驳计划或修订跟踪，以及第 4 阶段（), such as adversarial review, rebuttal planning, or revision tracking, and Phase 4 (传播Dissemination）主要仍然在当前的端到端管道之外。这种不平衡反映了整个调查中观察到的更广泛的模式：生成研究工件比以负责任的保真度验证、修改和传达它们更容易。) remains mostly outside current end-to-end pipelines. This imbalance reflects a broader pattern observed throughout the survey: it is easier to generate research artifacts than to validate, revise, and communicate them with accountable fidelity.

现有系统可以分为四个架构系列：顺序管道、基于搜索和自我改进的系统、基于技能和工具集成的系统以及多代理或社区规模的框架。Existing systems can be grouped into four architectural families: sequential pipelines, search-based and self-improving systems, skill-based and tool-integrated systems, and multi-agent or community-scale frameworks.

7.1.1 顺序和基于管道的系统Sequential and Pipeline-Based Systems

顺序系统以大部分线性顺序连接研究阶段，通常从想法产生到实验执行和手稿起草。人工智能科学家Sequential systems connect research stages in a mostly linear order, typically moving from idea generation to experiment execution and manuscript drafting. The AI Scientist[122]通过证明假设生成、代码执行、实验分析和论文写作可以组装成一个自动化工作流程，建立了这一范例。代理实验室established this paradigm by demonstrating that hypothesis generation, code execution, experimental analysis, and paper writing can be assembled into a single automated workflow. Agent Laboratory[171], AI-研究员, AI-Researcher[199], 周期研究员, CycleResearcher[220], 科斯莫斯, Kosmos[133], 海豚, Dolphin[244], 代码科学家, CodeScientist[77]，和内部代理, and InternAgent[248]通过选择不同的基础模型、任务范围和评估目标来实例化相关的流程设计。instantiate related pipeline designs with different choices of base models, task scopes, and evaluation targets.

顺序架构的优点是操作简单。每个阶段都会生成一个工件，该工件将成为下一阶段的输入，从而使工作流程可解释且相对容易实现。限制是错误传播。一个薄弱的想法可能会导致不相关的实验；不正确的代码可能会产生误导性的结果；未经证实的实验主张可以被打磨成看似合理的手稿。因此，顺序管道暴露了在整个生命周期中观察到的相同阶段边界风险：在一个阶段生成工件并不能保证下一阶段忠实地表示它或充分验证它。The advantage of sequential architectures is operational simplicity. Each stage produces an artifact that becomes the input to the next stage, making the workflow interpretable and relatively easy to implement. The limitation is error propagation. A weak idea can lead to irrelevant experiments; incorrect code can produce misleading results; and unsupported experimental claims can be polished into a plausible manuscript. Sequential pipelines therefore expose the same phase-boundary risk observed throughout the lifecycle: producing an artifact at one stage does not guarantee that the next stage represents it faithfully or verifies it adequately.

7.1.2 基于搜索和自我改进的系统Search-Based and Self-Improving Systems

第二个家族引入了搜索、进化或自我完善，以避免一次性一代的脆弱性。人工智能科学家 v2A second family introduces search, evolution, or self-improvement to avoid the brittleness of one-pass generation. AI Scientist v2[228]使用代理树搜索比其前身更系统地探索研究轨迹。 ASI进化uses agentic tree search to explore research trajectories more systematically than its predecessor. ASI-Evolve[226], AutoSOTA [107], 珊瑚色, CORAL[155]以及相关的进化系统搜索架构、算法、数据管理策略或多代理行为，以发现更强大的解决方案。, and related evolutionary systems search over architectures, algorithms, data curation strategies, or multi-agent behaviors to discover stronger solutions.

基于搜索的设计很重要，因为研究很少一次性进行。出色的工作通常来自分支替代方案、失败的实验、消融驱动的改进以及有选择的延续有前途的方向。因此，这些系统比直接管道更好地匹配科学实践的迭代结构。然而，仅靠搜索并不能解决验证问题。如果没有可靠的评估者，搜索可以针对特定于基准的工件、肤浅的新颖性或脆弱的改进进行优化。因此，核心设计问题不仅是系统搜索的范围有多广，还包括哪些信号指导选择以及这些信号是否反映科学价值而不是局部度量增益。Search-based designs are important because research rarely proceeds as a single pass. Strong work typically emerges from branching alternatives, failed experiments, ablation-driven refinement, and selective continuation of promising directions. These systems therefore better match the iterative structure of scientific practice than direct pipelines. However, search alone does not solve validation. Without reliable evaluators, search can optimize toward benchmark-specific artifacts, superficial novelty, or brittle improvements. The core design question is thus not only how broadly a system searches, but what signals guide selection and whether those signals reflect scientific value rather than local metric gains.

7.1.3 基于技能和工具集成的系统Skill-Based and Tool-Integrated Systems

基于技能的系统将研究工作流程打包为可组合功能，通常围绕编码代理、检索工具、实验运行器、文档编辑器和评估模块构建。阿里斯Skill-based systems package research workflows as composable capabilities, often built around coding agents, retrieval tools, experiment runners, document editors, and evaluation modules. ARIS[232]通过将研究自动化组织成可重复使用的工作流程来代表这一方向，以进行想法发现、自动审查和论文写作。自动研究爪represents this direction by organizing research automation into reusable workflows for idea discovery, auto-review, and paper writing. AutoResearchClaw[117]类似地，它实现了一个带有内部代理的多级管道，用于编码、基准测试和图形生成。更广泛的工具集成系统，例如 AutoAgentsimilarly implements a multi-stage pipeline with internal agents for coding, benchmarking, and figure generation. Broader tool-integrated systems such as AutoAgent[198], 比奥姆尼, Biomni[72], 科学科学GPT, SciSciGPT[177]，和研究爪, and ResearchClaw[231]强调检索、分析、代码执行、文档理解和特定领域工具的使用。emphasize retrieval, analytics, code execution, document understanding, and domain-specific tool use.

基于技能的架构的优势在于模块化。这些系统不是依赖一个整体代理来执行所有研究活动，而是为各个操作提供明确的工具和可重用的技能。这使得检查中间工件、交换组件和插入人工检查点变得更加容易。限制在于协调：模块化系统仍然需要可靠的跨阶段状态管理。如果想法、文献追踪、代码状态、实验日志、手稿声明、评审反馈和修订计划没有在共享和可更新的工作空间中体现，那么尽管存在许多工具，阶段切换仍然脆弱。The strength of skill-based architectures is modularity. Rather than relying on one monolithic agent to perform all research activities, these systems expose explicit tools and reusable skills for individual operations. This makes it easier to inspect intermediate artifacts, swap components, and insert human checkpoints. The limitation is coordination: modular systems still need reliable state management across stages. If the idea, literature trace, code state, experimental logs, manuscript claims, review feedback, and revision plan are not represented in a shared and updateable workspace, then phase handoffs remain fragile despite the presence of many tools.

7.1.4 多代理和社区规模系统Multi-Agent and Community-Scale Systems

多代理系统将研究任务分配给专门的代理，例如研究人员、工程师、审稿人、分析人员、作家或模拟社区成员。免费博士劳工Multi-agent systems distribute research tasks across specialized agents, such as researchers, engineers, reviewers, analyzers, writers, or simulated community members. FreePhDLabor[100], 科学大师, SciMaster[19], 进化科学家, EvoScientist[127], 联合科学家, UniScientist[99], 医学人工智能科学家, Medical AI Scientist[222], AiScientist-LH [23], FARS [8]，和自动研究爪, and AutoResearchClaw[117]说明不同形式的多代理编排。相关社区规模系统，例如 VirSciillustrate different forms of multi-agent orchestration. Related community-scale systems such as VirSci[193], AgentRxiv [170]、和研究城, and ResearchTown[242]进一步模拟科学合作的各个方面，包括思想交流、稿件撰写、评审和修订。further simulate aspects of scientific collaboration, including idea exchange, manuscript writing, review, and revision.

多智能体架构的动机是研究需要异构的专业知识和对抗性反馈。要求生成、执行、编写和批评自己的工作的单一模型很容易自我确认。分离角色可以通过引入专业化和跨代理批评来降低这种风险。然而，多智能体系统也引入了协调问题：智能体可能会重复工作，强化共同的误解，服从微弱的信号，或者在不提高科学质量的情况下产生冗长的审议。因此，最强大的多代理系统需要的不仅仅是代理数量；它们需要明确的角色分离、共享内存、基础工具和明确的验证机制。The motivation for multi-agent architectures is that research requires heterogeneous expertise and adversarial feedback. A single model asked to generate, execute, write, and critique its own work is prone to self-confirmation. Separating roles can reduce this risk by introducing specialization and cross-agent critique. However, multi-agent systems also introduce coordination problems: agents may duplicate work, reinforce shared misconceptions, defer to weak signals, or produce verbose deliberation without improving scientific quality. The strongest multi-agent systems therefore require more than agent count; they require clear role separation, shared memory, grounded tools, and explicit verification mechanisms.

7.1.5 评估：生命周期覆盖范围和阶段边界Assessment: Lifecycle Coverage and Phase Boundaries

端到端系统不仅应根据最终稿件的质量进行评估，还应根据生命周期覆盖范围和阶段边界可靠性进行评估。当前的系统在生成想法、代码、实验和论文草稿方面最强，但在外部验证、作者风格的修订和受众适应性传播方面较弱。这种不均匀的覆盖范围并非偶然：第一阶段（End-to-end systems should be evaluated not only by the quality of their final manuscript, but also by lifecycle coverage and phase-boundary reliability. Current systems are strongest at generating ideas, code, experiments, and paper drafts, but weaker at external validation, author-style revision, and audience-adaptive dissemination. This uneven coverage is not accidental: Stage 1 (创造Creation）和第二阶段（) and Stage 2 (写作Writing）产生工件，而第 3 阶段（) produce artifacts, whereas Stage 3 (验证Validation）和第 4 阶段（) and Stage 4 (传播Dissemination）需要判断力、责任感和观众意识的忠诚度。) require judgment, accountability, and audience-aware fidelity.

最重要的故障模式不是孤立的阶段故障，而是未经验证的切换。一个想法可能看起来很新颖，但在执行过程中却失败了；代码可以运行但实现了错误的算法；实验日志可以归纳为无支持的主张；自动审查可能是连贯但宽松的；反驳可能会承诺做出一些未实现的改变。端到端系统放大了这种风险，因为错误可以在各个阶段悄然传播。因此，一个成熟的生命周期规模的研究系统必须保留假设、检索到的证据、代码、实验、图表、手稿声明、评论、反驳和修订之间的可追踪联系。The most important failure mode is not isolated stage failure, but unverified handoff. An idea may appear novel but fail during execution; code may run but implement the wrong algorithm; experimental logs may be summarized into unsupported claims; an automated review may be coherent but lenient; and a rebuttal may promise changes that are not fulfilled. End-to-end systems amplify this risk because errors can propagate silently across stages. A mature lifecycle-scale research system must therefore preserve traceable links between hypotheses, retrieved evidence, code, experiments, figures, manuscript claims, reviews, rebuttals, and revisions.

报告的成本和质量指标进一步表明，代币预算本身并不是决定性因素。系统的成本差异很大，但更强大的结果通常来自搜索策略、工具集成、结构化分解和验证设计，而不是暴力生成。因此，中心评价问题正在从Reported costs and quality metrics further suggest that the token budget alone is not the decisive factor. Systems vary widely in cost, but stronger results often come from search strategy, tool integration, structured decomposition, and verification design rather than brute-force generation. The central evaluation question is therefore shifting from系统能出论文吗？Can the system produce a paper? to 系统能否在整个生命周期中保持科学保真度？Can the system maintain scientific fidelity across the complete lifecycle?

7.1.6 调查结果和观察结果Findings and Observations

7.2 整个研究生命周期的评估Evaluation Across the Research Lifecycle

评估是人工智能辅助研究的核心瓶颈。每个阶段都会产生不同的工件——想法、文献摘要、代码、实验、图表、手稿、评论、反驳和传播材料——因此没有一个单一的指标可以衡量整个生命周期的研究质量。因此，现有的基准已经从狭隘的特定于任务的评估发展到更广泛的、流程感知的、越来越以执行为基础的协议。Evaluation is the central bottleneck for AI-assisted research. Each stage produces different artifacts—ideas, literature summaries, code, experiments, figures, manuscripts, reviews, rebuttals, and dissemination materials—so no single metric can capture research quality across the full lifecycle. Existing benchmarks have therefore evolved from narrow task-specific evaluations toward broader, process-aware, and increasingly execution-grounded protocols.Table˜2，引入, introduced insection˜2.3，总结了八个阶段的主要基准。, summarizes major benchmarks across the eight stages.

在整个基准格局中，三个趋势是明显的。首先，评估正在从孤立的输出转向多维度的评估。早期的基准测试通常衡量单一能力，例如引文预测、代码执行或写作流畅性。最近的基准测试而是评估多个轴，例如构思的新颖性和可行性、文献综合的覆盖范围和引用准确性、研究代码的语义正确性、同行评审的评审一致性以及 Paper2X 工件的保真度。其次，基准测试变得更加具有领域和工作流程意识。专业评估现在针对 GPU 内核优化Across the benchmark landscape, three trends are clear. First, evaluation is moving from isolated outputs to a multi-dimensional assessment. Early benchmarks often measured a single capability, such as citation prediction, code execution, or writing fluency. Recent benchmarks instead evaluate multiple axes, such as novelty and feasibility in ideation, coverage and citation accuracy in literature synthesis, semantic correctness in research code, review consistency in peer review, and fidelity in Paper2X artifacts. Second, benchmarks are becoming more domain- and workflow-aware. Specialized evaluations now target GPU kernel optimization[143, 101], 生物学研究, biology research[96]、科学实验, scientific experimentation[92]，以及更广泛的与科学家一致的工作流程, and broader scientist-aligned workflows[16, 225]。第三，基准性能和现实世界的研究价值之间仍然存在持续的差距：系统可以在可衡量的代理上表现良好，但仍然产生专家认为浅薄、渐进或基础不足的输出. Third, a persistent gap remains between benchmark performance and real-world research value: systems can perform well on measurable proxies while still producing outputs that experts judge as shallow, incremental, or insufficiently grounded[266, 220].

7.2.1 特定阶段的基准Stage-Specific Benchmarks

针对特定阶段的基准仍然是必要的，因为研究生命周期的每个部分都需要不同的评估标准。Stage-specific benchmarks remain necessary because each part of the research lifecycle requires different evaluation criteria.

  • •

    对于For (创意产生Idea Generation），基准评估新颖性、可行性、多样性和下游潜力。这些评估很困难，因为表面上的新颖性可能无法在实施中幸存下来，而且专家对研究前景的判断本质上是嘈杂的。), benchmarks assess novelty, feasibility, diversity, and downstream potential. These evaluations are difficult because apparent novelty may not survive implementation, and expert judgments of research promise are inherently noisy.

  • •

    对于For (文献综述Literature Review），基准强调检索精度、引文保真度、覆盖完整性和综合质量。核心挑战不仅在于系统是否找到相关论文，还在于在构建叙述时是否忠实地使用它们。), benchmarks emphasize retrieval precision, citation fidelity, coverage completeness, and synthesis quality. The central challenge is not only whether the system finds relevant papers, but whether it uses them faithfully when constructing a narrative.

  • •

    对于For (编码和实验Coding and Experiments），基准测试逐渐超越代码执行，转向语义正确性和可重复性。研究代码基准测试会询问生成的实现是否与预期算法匹配，而更广泛的工作流程基准测试（例如 EXP-Bench）), benchmarks increasingly move beyond code execution toward semantic correctness and reproducibility. Research-code benchmarks ask whether generated implementations match the intended algorithm, while broader workflow benchmarks such as EXP-Bench[92]评估实验设计、执行和分析。evaluate experiment design, execution, and analysis.

  • •

    对于For (表格和数字Tables and Figures），评估必须区分视觉合理性和科学正确性：图表或表格可能看起来已准备好发表，但实际上歪曲了数据、符号或比较结构。), evaluation must distinguish visual plausibility from scientific correctness: a figure or table may look publication-ready while misrepresenting data, notation, or comparison structure.

  • •

    对于For (论文写作Paper Writing），评估结合了写作质量、引用准确性、事实基础和评论风格的判断。), evaluation combines writing quality, citation accuracy, factual grounding, and review-style judgment.

  • •

    对于For (同行评审Peer Review），基准评估一致性、基础性、偏见和操纵的鲁棒性，而不是仅仅审查流畅性。), benchmarks assess consistency, grounding, bias, and robustness to manipulation rather than review fluency alone.

  • •

    对于For (反驳与修改Rebuttal and Revision），新兴数据集将评论、作者回复和手稿更改进行调整，从而能够评估反驳是否真正解决了问题并导致完成修订。), emerging datasets align reviews, author responses, and manuscript changes, enabling evaluation of whether rebuttals actually address concerns and lead to fulfilled revisions.

  • •

    对于For (传播Dissemination），评估的重点是海报、幻灯片、视频、项目页面、社交媒体帖子和互动代理的保真度、可用性和受众适应性。这个阶段尤其困难，因为传播工件通常独立于报纸而传播，并且可以塑造公众对作品的理解。), evaluation centers on fidelity, usability, and audience adaptation across posters, slides, videos, project pages, social media posts, and interactive agents. This stage is especially difficult because dissemination artifacts often circulate independently of the paper and can shape public understanding of the work.

7.2.2 评估方法Evaluation Methodologies

当前的评估方法可分为五类。Current evaluation methodologies can be grouped into five families.专家评审Expert evaluation仍然是评估新颖性、重要性、正确性和科学贡献的最可靠的方法。硅remains the most credible approach for assessing novelty, significance, correctness, and scientific contribution. Si等人。et al. [183]，例如，招募超过, for example, recruited over100100NLP 研究人员评估生成的想法。然而，专家评估成本高昂、缓慢且嘈杂：即使是同行评审式的判断，评估者之间的一致性也有限，斯坦福大学 Agentic Reviewer 研究报告了人与人之间的相关性NLP researchers to evaluate generated ideas. However, expert evaluation is expensive, slow, and noisy: even peer-review-style judgments show limited inter-rater agreement, with the Stanford Agentic Reviewer study reporting human–human correlation aroundρ=0.41\rho=0.41 [80]。这使得专家评估不可或缺，但难以规模化。. This makes expert evaluation indispensable but difficult to scale.

法学硕士作为法官和代理人作为法官LLM-as-Judge and Agent-as-Judge方法提供了人类评估的可扩展近似值。周期审阅者methods provide scalable approximations of human assessment. CycleReviewer[220]报告一个reports a26.89%26.89\%相对于单个人类审稿人进行分数预测，代理 MAE 减少，而斯坦福代理审稿人reduction in Proxy MAE relative to individual human reviewers for score prediction, while the Stanford Agentic Reviewer[80]实现与人类评分者间一致性相当的评论评分相关性（achieves review-score correlations comparable to human inter-rater agreement (ρ=0.42\rho=0.42与人类相比vs. humanρ=0.41\rho=0.41）。这些结果表明，自动评估器可以提供有用的评论式信号，但它们仍然是不完美的代理。他们可能表现出积极偏见、长度偏见、权威偏见、自我偏好以及对对抗性提示的脆弱性). These results show that automated evaluators can provide useful review-style signals, but they remain imperfect proxies. They can exhibit positivity bias, length bias, authority bias, self-preference, and vulnerability to adversarial prompts[266, 240]。因此，当根据专家判断进行校准并与特定任务的验证相结合时，基于法学硕士的评估是最可靠的。. As a result, LLM-based evaluation is most reliable when calibrated against expert judgments and combined with task-specific verification.

自动化指标Automated metrics提供客观但狭窄的信号。代码执行成功率、单元测试通过率、引用准确性、接受预测和传统文本生成指标（例如 BLEU）offer objective but narrow signals. Code execution success, unit-test pass rates, citation accuracy, acceptance prediction, and traditional text-generation metrics such as BLEU[148], 胭脂, ROUGE[112]和 BERT 分数, and BERTScore[254]易于计算，但它们仅捕获研究质量的片段。例如，可执行代码仍然可能在语义上是错误的，准确的引用仍然可以用来支持误导性的主张，流畅的文本仍然可能缺乏贡献。对任何一项指标的过度优化都会面临古德哈特定律的风险。are easy to compute, but they capture only fragments of research quality. For example, executable code can still be semantically wrong, accurate citations can still be used to support misleading claims, and fluent text can still lack contribution. Over-optimization on any one metric risks Goodhart’s law.

以执行为基础的评估Execution-grounded evaluation通过运行代码、重现实验或根据生成的证据检查声明来验证研究成果。这个范式对于verifies research outputs by running code, reproducing experiments, or checking claims against generated evidence. This paradigm is especially important for，但它也会影响写作和验证，因为手稿声明应该可追溯到已执行的实验。纸凳, but it also affects Writing and Validation because manuscript claims should be traceable to executed experiments. PaperBench[192]例如，将论文分解为可单独评分的子任务，可以通过实施和执行来检查这些子任务。硅, for example, decomposes papers into individually gradable subtasks that can be checked through implementation and execution. Si等人。et al. [185]进一步表明，执行引导搜索可以通过使用经验反馈而不是单独的文本判断来改进发现工作流程。further show that execution-guided search can improve discovery workflows by using empirical feedback rather than textual judgment alone.

基于过程和跟踪的评估Process- and trace-based evaluation评估系统如何达到输出，而不仅仅是最终的工件。这包括深入研究中的工具使用轨迹、反驳中的审稿人评论分解、作者回复后的修订完成以及论文内容和传播材料之间的保真度。这种范例变得越来越重要，因为许多生命周期失败发生在交接时：系统可能检索到正确的论文但错误地引用它，进行实验但总结不准确，或者承诺反驳修订但没有实施它。assesses how a system reaches an output, not only the final artifact. This includes tool-use trajectories in deep research, reviewer-comment decomposition in rebuttal, revision fulfillment after author responses, and fidelity between paper content and dissemination materials. This paradigm is increasingly important because many lifecycle failures occur at handoffs: a system may retrieve the right paper but cite it incorrectly, run an experiment but summarize it inaccurately, or promise a rebuttal revision without implementing it.

7.2.3 新兴的评估范式Emerging Evaluation Paradigms

一些新兴范式正在重塑人工智能辅助研究的评估。第一个是Several emerging paradigms are reshaping evaluation for AI-assisted research. The first is以执行为基础的评估execution-grounded evaluation，其中声明根据可执行工件进行检查，而不是仅根据文本进行判断。这对于表面合理性不足的研究编码、论文复制和实验分析至关重要。它还提供了评估写作的途径：手稿声明应该可追溯到图形、表格、日志或执行的实验。, where claims are checked against executable artifacts rather than judged only from text. This is essential for research coding, paper replication, and experimental analysis, where surface plausibility is insufficient. It also provides a path toward evaluating Writing: a manuscript claim should be traceable to a figure, table, log, or executed experiment.

第二个是The second is对抗性评价adversarial evaluation。正如中所讨论的. As discussed in (同行评审Peer Review），基于法学硕士的审稿人和法官很容易受到提示注入、词汇触发和隐蔽内容操纵的影响。打破审稿人), LLM-based reviewers and judges are vulnerable to prompt injection, lexical triggers, and covert content manipulation. Breaking the Reviewer[113]相关研究表明，对操纵的鲁棒性必须被视为一个评估维度，而不是一个外围安全问题。这对于验证尤其重要，其中操纵的审查或判断可能会影响接受决定。and related studies show that robustness to manipulation must be treated as an evaluation dimension rather than a peripheral security issue. This is particularly important for Validation, where a manipulated review or judge can affect acceptance decisions.

第三个是The third is长期评估long-horizon evaluation。许多基准测试仍然是短期的，评估需要几分钟或几小时而不是几周或几个月的任务。然而，真正的研究涉及延迟反馈、失败的尝试、不断变化的假设和不断变化的证据。 METR 的分析表明人工智能的任务范围正在迅速扩大. Many benchmarks remain short-horizon, evaluating tasks that take minutes or hours rather than weeks or months. However, real research involves delayed feedback, failed attempts, changing hypotheses, and evolving evidence. METR’s analysis suggests that AI task horizons are rapidly increasing[131]，而重新基准, while RE-Bench[221]提供开放式的机器学习研发环境，开始近似更长的研究工作流程。尽管如此，当前的长期基准仍然比真实的研究项目短得多、更清晰。provides open-ended ML R&D environments that begin to approximate longer research workflows. Still, current long-horizon benchmarks remain far shorter and cleaner than authentic research projects.

第四个是The fourth is生命周期级评估lifecycle-level evaluation。现有的基准测试通常一次评估一个阶段，但许多重要的故障发生在阶段之间。未来的生命周期基准应该测试一个想法在实施后是否仍然有效，检索到的文献是否忠实地以书面形式表达，实验证据是否支持手稿的主张，反驳承诺是否得到履行，以及传播工件是否保留主张和限制。这种评估将更好地匹配端到端研究自动化的真实风险状况。. Existing benchmarks usually evaluate one stage at a time, but many important failures occur between stages. A future lifecycle benchmark should test whether an idea remains valid after implementation, whether retrieved literature is faithfully represented in writing, whether experimental evidence supports manuscript claims, whether rebuttal commitments are fulfilled, and whether dissemination artifacts preserve claims and limitations. Such evaluation would better match the real risk profile of end-to-end research automation.

7.2.4 评估差距Evaluation Gaps

尽管进展迅速，但仍有一些差距尚未解决。首先，Despite rapid progress, several gaps remain unresolved. First,新颖性和意义仍然难以定义novelty and significance are still difficult to define。专家的判断因审稿人、地点和领域的不同而有所不同，自动新颖性评分可以奖励那些听起来原创但在执行后失败的想法。第二，. Expert judgments vary across reviewers, venues, and fields, and automated novelty scores can reward ideas that sound original but fail after execution. Second,基准污染和时间有效性是持续存在的问题benchmark contamination and temporal validity are persistent concerns。许多任务源自模型训练数据中可能出现的公开论文、代码或评论。时间分割有所帮助，但它们会带来主题、难度和社区标准的变化。. Many tasks are derived from public papers, code, or reviews that may appear in model training data. Temporal splits help, but they introduce changes in topic, difficulty, and community standards.

三、Third,跨系统比较仍然很困难cross-system comparison remains difficult。通常使用不同的基本模型、提示、工具、数据集、计算预算和人机交互假设来评估系统。这使得报告的结果很难比较，即使它们针对的是同一阶段。四、. Systems are often evaluated with different base models, prompts, tools, datasets, compute budgets, and human-in-the-loop assumptions. This makes reported results hard to compare even when they target the same stage. Fourth,跨域泛化仍有待测试cross-domain generalization remains under-tested。大多数基准测试侧重于机器学习和自然语言处理，而化学、生物学、材料科学、物理学、医学和社会科学则需要不同的证据标准、实验工作流程和特定领域的工具。. Most benchmarks focus on machine learning and NLP, while chemistry, biology, materials science, physics, medicine, and social science require different evidence standards, experimental workflows, and domain-specific tools.

第五、Fifth,计算成本本身就是一个评估维度computational cost is itself an evaluation dimension。一些研究任务，例如论文复制、长期实验和多模式传播，需要大量的代币、计算或工具使用预算。如果系统的成本过高或者其结果在现实约束下无法重现，那么在无限采样下表现良好的系统可能在实际中没有用处。. Some research tasks, such as paper replication, long-horizon experimentation, and multimodal dissemination, require substantial token, compute, or tool-use budgets. A system that performs well under unlimited sampling may not be practically useful if its cost is prohibitive or its results are not reproducible under realistic constraints.

最后，Finally,没有现有的基准能够以与人类同等的严格性来评估完整的研究生命周期no existing benchmark evaluates the complete research lifecycle with human-equivalent rigor。纸凳. PaperBench[192]在复制方面取得了重要进展，并且流程感知基准在文献综述、编码、同行评审、反驳和 Paper2X 中不断出现。然而，目前还没有基准可以评估从构思到传播的整个链条，同时保留跨工件的可追溯性。这种生命周期评估差距是核心：没有它，系统可能在各个阶段显得很强大，但无法在整个研究过程中保持科学保真度。makes important progress for replication, and process-aware benchmarks are emerging across literature review, coding, peer review, rebuttal, and Paper2X. However, no benchmark yet evaluates the full chain from ideation to dissemination while preserving traceability across artifacts. This lifecycle evaluation gap is central: without it, systems may appear strong within individual stages while failing to maintain scientific fidelity across the research process.

7.3 跨领域的见解Cross-Cutting Insights

前面的部分揭示了整个研究生命周期的一致模式：人工智能系统越来越有能力产生类似研究的工件，但在验证这些工件是否新颖、忠实、可执行和具有科学意义时仍然不太可靠。我们从阶段级分析中提炼出五个跨领域的见解。这些见解并不依赖于单一工具或基准；相反，它们描述了在创建、编写、验证和传播过程中出现的重复出现的能力边界和部署原则。The preceding sections reveal a consistent pattern across the research lifecycle: AI systems are increasingly capable of producing research-like artifacts, but remain less reliable at verifying whether those artifacts are novel, faithful, executable, and scientifically meaningful. We distill five cross-cutting insights from the stage-level analysis. These insights are not tied to a single tool or benchmark; rather, they describe recurring capability boundaries and deployment principles that appear across Creation, Writing, Validation, and Dissemination.

7.3.1 文物生成速度超过科学验证速度Artifact Generation Outpaces Scientific Verification

在整个生命周期中，人工智能系统更擅长生产工件，而不是验证其科学有效性。在Across the lifecycle, AI systems are better at producing artifacts than at verifying their scientific validity. In (创意产生Idea Generation），产生的想法可能显得新颖且动机良好，但在实施后却会减弱。硅), generated ideas can appear novel and well-motivated, yet weaken after implementation. Si等人。et al. [184]表明人工智能生成的想法在执行后比人类的想法退化得更快，暴露出表面新颖性和可执行实质内容之间的差距。在show that AI-generated ideas degrade more sharply after execution than human ideas, exposing a gap between apparent novelty and executable substance. In (编码和实验Coding and Experiments），生成的代码可能会在实现错误的算法时成功运行，其中语义错误构成了主要的错误来源), generated code may run successfully while implementing the wrong algorithm, with semantic failures forming a major source of error[71]。在. In (表格和数字Tables and Figures），生成的视觉伪影可能看起来很精美，但同时歪曲了数据、符号或信息流。在), generated visual artifacts may look polished while misrepresenting data, notation, or information flow. In (论文写作Paper Writing），流畅的散文可以掩盖薄弱的推理或没有支持的主张。), fluent prose can conceal weak reasoning or unsupported claims.

这种差距也出现在验证和传播中。在This gap also appears in Validation and Dissemination. In (同行评审Peer Review），自动评审可以连贯一致，同时无法检测出决定性的方法缺陷或分配夸大的分数), automated reviews can be coherent and consistent while under-detecting decisive methodological flaws or assigning inflated scores[266, 142]。在. In (反驳与修改Rebuttal and Revision），生成的回复可能听起来有说服力，但其价值取决于承诺的证据或手稿更改是否实际履行), generated responses may sound persuasive, but their value depends on whether promised evidence or manuscript changes are actually fulfilled[21]。在. In (传播Dissemination）、海报、幻灯片、视频和社交媒体摘要可以通过夸大主张或忽略限制的方式简化论文。因此，生命周期的中心问题不仅仅是工件的生产，而是工件的验证：每个输出都必须保持可追溯的证据、假设和限制。), posters, slides, videos, and social media summaries can simplify a paper in ways that overstate claims or omit limitations. The central lifecycle problem is therefore not artifact production alone, but artifact verification: each output must remain traceable to evidence, assumptions, and limitations.

7.3.2 人控协作仍然是最可靠的部署模式Human-Governed Collaboration Remains the Most Reliable Deployment Mode

跨阶段最强的部署模式不是完全自治，而是人为管理的协作。在写作中，半自动化系统在协助规划、起草、润色和引文支持，同时研究人员保留对论证、解释和最终责任的控制时是最可信的。在同行评审中，最有效的验证设置不是独立的 AI 评审，而是 AI 对人类评审的反馈：ICLR 2025 随机研究表明，LLM 反馈提高了评审质量The strongest deployment pattern across stages is not full autonomy, but human-governed collaboration. In Writing, semi-automated systems are most credible when they assist planning, drafting, polishing, and citation support while researchers retain control over argumentation, interpretation, and final responsibility. In Peer Review, the strongest validated setting is not standalone AI review, but AI feedback on human reviews: the ICLR 2025 randomized study shows that LLM feedback improved review quality in89%89\%不影响受理率的情况下of cases without affecting acceptance rates[202]。在反驳中，作者感知系统比通用响应生成更合适，因为反驳必须反映论文的实际贡献和作者的预期修订. In Rebuttal, author-aware systems are more appropriate than generic response generation because rebuttals must reflect the paper’s actual contributions and the authors’ intended revisions[163]。在传播中，人工智能生成的海报、幻灯片、视频和公共摘要最好被视为可编辑的草稿，其主张和重点仍由作者控制。. In Dissemination, AI-generated posters, slides, videos, and public summaries are best treated as editable drafts whose claims and emphasis remain under author control.

这种模式解释了为什么直接自动化在高风险的研究环境中存在风险。研究需要在不确定性下进行判断：决定一个想法是否值得追求、实验是否充分、批评是否有效、反驳承诺是否可行以及面向公众的总结是否忠实。这些决定恰恰是当前系统仍然脆弱的地方。因此，当人工智能援助扩大研究人员的能力，同时保留人类对科学主张、证据解释和问责制的监督时，它是最有用的。This pattern explains why direct automation is risky in high-stakes research settings. Research requires judgment under uncertainty: deciding whether an idea is worth pursuing, whether an experiment is sufficient, whether a critique is valid, whether a rebuttal promise is feasible, and whether a public-facing summary is faithful. These decisions are precisely where current systems remain fragile. AI assistance is therefore most useful when it expands researcher capacity while preserving human oversight over scientific claims, evidence interpretation, and accountability.

7.3.3 开放式研究任务中出现能力边界Capability Boundaries Emerge in Open-Ended Research Tasks

当任务变得新颖、不明确或长期时，就会出现最尖锐的能力边界。当前的系统在具有清晰反馈的结构化任务上表现出色，例如标准软件问题解决、语法纠正、简单绘图和格式转换。当任务需要解释隐含的假设、设计有意义的实验、重现未指定的方法或判断科学贡献时，绩效就会下降。这在研究编码中最为明显：虽然前沿系统在熟悉的软件基准测试中表现良好，但在新颖的研究代码任务上性能急剧下降，报告的上限约为The sharpest capability boundaries appear when tasks become novel, underspecified, or long-horizon. Current systems perform strongly on structured tasks with clear feedback, such as standard software issue resolution, grammar correction, simple plotting, and format conversion. Performance drops when the task requires interpreting implicit assumptions, designing meaningful experiments, reproducing underspecified methods, or judging scientific contribution. This is most visible in research coding: while frontier systems perform well on familiar software benchmarks, performance falls sharply on novel research-code tasks, with reported ceilings around3737–39%39\%在专用基准上on dedicated benchmarks[71, 224].

类似的界限在其他地方也出现过。文献综述系统越来越好地检索和总结单篇论文，但在多论文关系推理和引文保真度方面遇到困难。创意生成系统产生看似合理的假设，但面临持续的新颖性与可行性的权衡。论文写作系统可以生成流畅的手稿，但在论证深度和审稿人预期方面仍然较弱。同行评审系统可以近似评审风格，但仍然容易受到宽大处理、偏见和操纵的影响。这些失败有一个共同的结构：任务不能仅通过模式匹配来解决，因为成功取决于隐含的领域知识、因果推理、长期反馈和专家判断。Similar boundaries recur elsewhere. Literature review systems retrieve and summarize individual papers increasingly well, but struggle with multi-paper relational reasoning and citation fidelity. Idea-generation systems produce plausible hypotheses but face persistent novelty–feasibility tradeoffs. Paper-writing systems generate fluent manuscripts but remain weaker at argumentative depth and reviewer anticipation. Peer-review systems can approximate review style but remain vulnerable to leniency, bias, and manipulation. These failures share a common structure: the task cannot be solved by pattern matching alone, because success depends on implicit domain knowledge, causal reasoning, long-horizon feedback, and expert judgment.

7.3.4 有效的系统融合在分层架构上Effective Systems Converge on Layered Architectures

在各个阶段中，最有能力的系统越来越多地结合三个层：Across phases, the most capable systems increasingly combine three layers:探索exploration, 执行execution, 和, and验证verification。探索层搜索假设、论文集、代码变体、响应计划或设计替代方案。执行层与工具交互：检索引擎、代码解释器、实验运行器、绘图库、文档编辑器或演示生成器。验证层通过执行反馈、引文验证、批评、审稿人模拟或人工审阅来检查中间输出是否接地、正确和有用。. The exploration layer searches over hypotheses, paper collections, code variants, response plans, or design alternatives. The execution layer interacts with tools: retrieval engines, code interpreters, experiment runners, plotting libraries, document editors, or presentation generators. The verification layer checks whether intermediate outputs are grounded, correct, and useful, through execution feedback, citation validation, critique, reviewer simulation, or human review.

这种分层视图解释了为什么简单的提示不足以实现研究自动化。研究任务很少只需要一代步骤；他们需要提出替代方案，对其进行测试，根据反馈进行修改，并在迭代中保留状态。基于搜索的系统改进探索，工具集成系统加强执行，多代理系统可以支持专业化和批判。然而，更多的代理并不会自动提高性能。当任务可以分解为并行或角色专用的子任务时，多代理系统显得最有用；当协调开销和错误传播占主导地位时，它们可能会降低顺序推理任务的性能This layered view explains why simple prompting is insufficient for research automation. Research tasks rarely require only one generation step; they require proposing alternatives, testing them, revising based on feedback, and preserving state across iterations. Search-based systems improve exploration, tool-integrated systems strengthen execution, and multi-agent systems can support specialization and critique. However, more agents do not automatically improve performance. Multi-agent systems appear most useful when the task can be decomposed into parallel or role-specialized subtasks; they can degrade on sequential reasoning tasks when coordination overhead and error propagation dominate[89]。因此，重要的设计原则不是代理数量，而是架构是否与任务结构匹配并包含可靠的验证。. Thus, the important design principle is not agent count, but whether the architecture matches the task structure and includes reliable verification.

7.3.5 人工智能的使用已成为治理问题，而不是检测问题AI Use Has Become a Governance Problem, Not a Detection Problem

人工智能辅助已经嵌入研究生态系统中。语料库级别的研究估计在科学写作的重要部分中可检测到的人工智能修改，包括多达AI assistance is already embedded in the research ecosystem. Corpus-level studies estimate detectable AI modification in a nontrivial fraction of scientific writing, including up to17.5%17.5\%计算机科学文摘of computer science abstracts[109]和and13.5%13.5\%生物医学文摘of biomedical abstracts[90]。自我报告的采用率更高，许多研究人员使用人工智能来完成写作或审阅相关任务. Self-reported adoption is higher, with many researchers using AI for writing or review-related tasks[134]。与此同时，语言标记研究表明，在引入法学硕士后，与人工智能相关的词汇可能会激增，但这些信号对于判断个案并不可靠，并且可能会随着用户和模型的适应而发生变化。. At the same time, linguistic marker studies show that AI-associated words can surge after the introduction of LLMs, but such signals are unreliable for adjudicating individual cases and can change as users and models adapt.

政策含义是，社区应该从以检测为中心的执法转向披露、归属和问责。检测工具可能会产生误报，特别是对于正式或非本地学术散文，而水印仍然依赖于提供商的合作和释义的稳健性The policy implication is that the community should move from detection-centered enforcement toward disclosure, attribution, and accountability. Detection tools can produce false positives, especially for formal or non-native academic prose, while watermarking remains dependent on provider cooperation and robustness to paraphrasing[159]。因此，更持久的治理问题是：必须披露哪些形式的人工智能援助？审查期间允许哪些用途？谁对人工智能生成的主张、引文、反驳承诺或公开摘要负责？场馆应如何在不惩罚合法写作支持的情况下审核高风险使用？随着人工智能成为研究实践的常规部分，治理必须少关注人工智能是否被使用，而更多地关注其使用是否维护了科学完整性。. The more durable governance questions are therefore: What forms of AI assistance must be disclosed? Which uses are allowed during review? Who is responsible for AI-generated claims, citations, rebuttal commitments, or public summaries? How should venues audit high-risk uses without penalizing legitimate writing support? As AI becomes a routine part of research practice, governance must focus less on whether AI was used at all and more on whether its use preserved scientific integrity.

7.4 开放的挑战和未来的方向Open Challenges and Future Directions

尽管整个研究生命周期取得了快速进展，但前面的分析表明，可靠的人工智能辅助研究的主要障碍不仅仅是缺少工具。更困难的问题涉及人工智能系统是否能够跨阶段边界保持忠实性、评估科学价值、验证证据、支持负责任的治理、跨领域泛化以及保留人类专业知识。我们围绕这六个主题组织剩余的挑战。Despite rapid progress across the research lifecycle, the preceding analysis shows that the main barriers to reliable AI-assisted research are not merely missing tools. The harder problems concern whether AI systems can preserve faithfulness across phase boundaries, evaluate scientific value, verify evidence, support responsible governance, generalize across domains, and preserve human expertise. We organize the remaining challenges around these six themes.

7.4.1 跨越相界的忠诚Faithfulness Across Phase Boundaries

许多最严重的故障不是发生在单个阶段内，而是发生在工件从一个阶段移动到下一阶段时。一个看起来很有前途的想法Many of the most consequential failures occur not within a single stage, but when artifacts move from one phase to the next. An idea that appears promising in (创意产生Idea Generation）实施后可能会减弱) may weaken after implementation in (编码和实验Coding and Experiments）；检索到的证据); retrieved evidence in (文献综述Literature Review）可能会被歪曲) may be misrepresented in (论文写作Paper Writing）；实验结果来自); experimental results from (编码和实验Coding and Experiments）可以归纳为比数据支持更有力的主张；审稿人关注的问题) may be summarized into claims that are stronger than the data support; reviewer concerns in (同行评审Peer Review）可能会导致反驳承诺) may lead to rebuttal promises in (反驳与修改Rebuttal and Revision) 未履行的；和传播成果) that are not fulfilled; and dissemination outputs in (传播Dissemination）可能会简化其证据之外的贡献。) may simplify the contribution beyond its evidence.

这个相边界问题对于端到端系统尤其重要。生命周期规模的系统不仅必须生成工件，还必须保留它们之间的可追踪链接：假设应与检索到的文献相关联，代码应与实验相关联，图表应与日志相关联，手稿声明应与证据相关联，反驳承诺应与修订相关联，面向公众的摘要应与经过验证的论文相关联。当前的系统很少在整个生命周期中保持这种级别的来源。因此，未来的系统应该将阶段切换视为显式验证检查点，而不是模块之间的隐式转换。This phase-boundary problem is especially important for end-to-end systems. A lifecycle-scale system must not only generate artifacts, but preserve traceable links between them: hypotheses should connect to retrieved literature, code should connect to experiments, figures should connect to logs, manuscript claims should connect to evidence, rebuttal commitments should connect to revisions, and public-facing summaries should connect to the validated paper. Current systems rarely maintain this level of provenance across the full lifecycle. Future systems should therefore treat phase handoffs as explicit verification checkpoints rather than implicit transitions between modules.

7.4.2 科学判断与新颖性评估Scientific Judgment and Novelty Assessment

科学判断仍然很难自动化，因为研究质量不能简化为表面新颖性、流畅性或基准分数。在构思过程中，生成的提案在执行前可能显得新颖，但在实施后却无法保持可行性或影响力。多样性也是一个持续存在的问题：法学硕士产生的想法可能聚集在想法空间的狭窄区域，限制了他们探索真正不同的研究方向的能力Scientific judgment remains difficult to automate because research quality is not reducible to surface novelty, fluency, or benchmark score. In ideation, generated proposals can appear novel before execution but fail to remain feasible or impactful after implementation. Diversity is also a persistent concern: LLM-generated ideas may cluster in narrow regions of the idea space, limiting their ability to explore genuinely distinct research directions[79]。在文献综述中，系统越来越多地检索和总结单篇论文，但仍然难以解决多篇论文的关系推理、方法论沿袭和跨论文矛盾。. In literature review, systems increasingly retrieve and summarize individual papers well, but still struggle with multi-paper relational reasoning, methodological lineage, and cross-paper contradictions.

更深层次的挑战是新颖性、重要性和贡献是在社会和时间上定位的。一个好的研究想法取决于特定领域的背景、可行性、时机、社区标准和证据的可用性。因此，自动新颖性评分可以奖励听起来原创的想法，但忽略它们是否可执行、重要或与之前的工作有显着不同。未来的进展可能需要结合检索、时间分割、专家判断、执行反馈和下游影响分析的评估方法，而不是仅仅依赖法学硕士作为法官的分数。The deeper challenge is that novelty, significance, and contribution are socially and temporally situated. A good research idea depends on field-specific context, feasibility, timing, community standards, and the availability of evidence. Automated novelty scoring can therefore reward ideas that sound original while missing whether they are executable, important, or meaningfully different from prior work. Future progress will likely require evaluation methods that combine retrieval, temporal splits, expert judgment, execution feedback, and downstream impact analysis, rather than relying on LLM-as-Judge scores alone.

7.4.3 验证、再现性和责任Verification, Reproducibility, and Accountability

验证是自主研究系统尚未解决的核心问题。在编码和实验中，生成的代码可能会在实施错误的算法时成功执行，并且自动实验运行程序可能会产生看似定量的输出，但没有科学意义。纸质复制仍然特别困难：PaperBenchVerification is the central unresolved problem for autonomous research systems. In coding and experiments, generated code may execute successfully while implementing the wrong algorithm, and automated experiment runners can produce outputs that appear quantitative without being scientifically meaningful. Paper replication remains particularly difficult: PaperBench[192]表明当前的智能体在重现研究结果方面仍远远低于人类的表现。这表明即使验证现有的工作也还没有解决，更不用说生成可独立复制的新工作了。shows that current agents still fall far short of human performance on reproducing research results. This indicates that even verifying existing work is not yet solved, let alone generating new work that is independently reproducible.

反驳和修改暴露了并行的问责问题。只有当其主张得到支持并履行其承诺时，反驳才具有科学意义。 ICLR 2025 中观察到的承诺与履行差距Rebuttal and revision expose a parallel accountability problem. A rebuttal is scientifically meaningful only if its claims are supported and its commitments are fulfilled. The commitment–fulfillment gap observed in ICLR 2025[21]表明有说服力的回应文本是不够的：系统必须跟踪承诺的实验、澄清和修订是否实际上被纳入。因此，未来的人工智能研究系统应该包括明确的证据分类账、实验出处、版本化手稿差异和修订跟踪机制。我们的目标不仅是生产更强大的工件，而且使每项声明都可审计。shows that persuasive response text is insufficient: systems must track whether promised experiments, clarifications, and revisions are actually incorporated. Future AI research systems should therefore include explicit evidence ledgers, experiment provenance, versioned manuscript diffs, and revision-tracking mechanisms. The goal is not only to produce stronger artifacts, but to make every claim auditable.

7.4.4 引文、版本控制和来源来源Citation, Versioning, and Source Provenance

引文验证不是通过添加检索或网络搜索来解决的。科学记录是有版本的：相同的贡献可能会以 arXiv 预印本、研讨会论文、会议版本、期刊扩展或修订后的技术报告的形式出现，但标题、作者、地点、年份、DOI 以及有时的内容会发生变化。书目数据库可能会以不同的方式合并或分离这些记录，并且先前关于 arXiv-出版商引文合并的工作表明版本合并本身就是一个不平凡的文献计量问题Citation verification is not solved by adding retrieval or web search. Scientific records are versioned: the same contribution may appear as an arXiv preprint, workshop paper, conference version, journal extension, or revised technical report, with changes to title, authors, venue, year, DOI, and sometimes content. Bibliographic databases may merge or separate these records differently, and prior work on arXiv–publisher citation consolidation shows that version merging is itself a nontrivial bibliometric problem[44].

这给人工智能辅助文献综述、写作和传播带来了挑战。生成的手稿可能会引用正确的想法，但会从不一致的版本中收集元数据，或者在引用一个版本的同时引用另一个版本的声明。现有的引文审核工具和基准针对伪造或不受支持的参考文献This creates a challenge for AI-assisted literature review, writing, and dissemination. A generated manuscript may cite the correct idea but assemble metadata from inconsistent versions, or quote a claim from one version while citing another. Existing citation-audit tools and benchmarks target fabricated or unsupported references[151, 215]，但端到端研究代理还需要, but end-to-end research agents also need版本一致的引用汇编version-consistent citation assembly：标题、作者、地点、年份、URL/DOI 和引用的声明应来自同一选定记录，并保留出处。因此，未来的系统不应将引用视为格式化任务，而应视为版本化的源基础问题。: title, authors, venue, year, URL/DOI, and quoted claims should come from the same selected record, with provenance preserved. Future systems should therefore treat citation not as a formatting task, but as a versioned source-grounding problem.

7.4.5 治理、披露和研究诚信Governance, Disclosure, and Research Integrity

人工智能在研究中的应用不再是假设。写作协助、审稿支持、文献检索、代码生成和传播起草已经成为许多研究人员工作流程的一部分。这使得治理成为一个核心挑战。基于检测的执行并不可靠，因为人工智能文本检测器可能会产生误报，尤其是对于正式的学术写作、非母语散文或经过大量编辑的文本。正如中所讨论的AI use in research is no longer hypothetical. Writing assistance, review support, literature search, code generation, and dissemination drafting are already part of many researchers’ workflows. This makes governance a central challenge. Detection-based enforcement is unreliable because AI text detectors can produce false positives, especially for formal academic writing, non-native prose, or heavily edited text. As discussed in (论文写作Paper Writing）和) and (同行评审Peer Review），因此，社区正在从试图检测人工智能使用的每一个实例转向要求披露、归属和问责。), the community is therefore shifting from trying to detect every instance of AI use toward requiring disclosure, attribution, and accountability.

悬而未决的问题是如何定义跨阶段负责任的人工智能使用。协助语法纠正不同于生成实验主张；起草反驳意见与承诺新实验不同；使用人工智能来改进审核与委托审核本身不同。场所、出版商和机构需要制定政策来区分低风险援助和高风险替代，明确必须披露的内容，并明确谁对人工智能生成的内容负责。核心治理原则应该是，作者仍然对主张、引用、实验、反驳承诺和面向公众的摘要负责，无论哪种人工智能工具有助于其生产。The open question is how to define responsible AI use across stages. Assistance with grammar correction is different from generating experimental claims; drafting a rebuttal is different from promising new experiments; using AI to improve a review is different from delegating the review itself. Venues, publishers, and institutions need policies that distinguish low-risk assistance from high-risk substitution, specify what must be disclosed, and clarify who is accountable for AI-generated content. The central governance principle should be that authors remain responsible for claims, citations, experiments, rebuttal commitments, and public-facing summaries, regardless of which AI tools contributed to their production.

7.4.6 跨域泛化和基础设施访问Cross-Domain Generalization and Infrastructure Access

当前大多数系统和基准测试都集中在计算机科学、机器学习和 NLP 领域。将人工智能辅助研究扩展到化学、生物学、医学、材料科学、物理学和社会科学，需要的不仅仅是对领域论文的再培训。这些领域在证据标准、实验基础设施、安全限制、数据可用性和社区规范方面有所不同。系统如Google AI Co-scientistMost current systems and benchmarks are concentrated in computer science, machine learning, and NLP. Extending AI-assisted research to chemistry, biology, medicine, materials science, physics, and social science requires more than retraining on domain papers. These fields differ in evidence standards, experimental infrastructure, safety constraints, data availability, and community norms. Systems such as Google AI Co-scientist[54], 比奥姆尼, Biomni[72], 医学人工智能科学家, Medical AI Scientist[222]，特定领域的实验室代理指向这个方向，但广泛的跨领域泛化仍未解决。, and domain-specific laboratory agents point toward this direction, but broad cross-domain generalization remains unresolved.

基础设施接入也是同一挑战的一部分。有些领域需要专门的仪器、湿实验室协议、专有数据集或昂贵的计算。如果先进的人工智能研究工具只能提供给资源充足的实验室或公司，它们可能会加剧科学生产中现有的不平等。因此，未来的系统不仅应该根据性能来评估，还应该根据现实资源限制下的可访问性、可重复性和可部署性来评估。开源工具、标准化接口、共享基准和透明的来源机制对于防止研究自动化成为基础设施特权非常重要。Infrastructure access is part of the same challenge. Some domains require specialized instruments, wet-lab protocols, proprietary datasets, or expensive compute. If advanced AI research tools are available only to well-resourced laboratories or companies, they may amplify existing inequalities in scientific production. Future systems should therefore be evaluated not only by performance, but also by accessibility, reproducibility, and deployability under realistic resource constraints. Open-source tools, standardized interfaces, shared benchmarks, and transparent provenance mechanisms will be important for preventing research automation from becoming an infrastructure privilege.

7.4.7 人类的专业知识和认知所有权Human Expertise and Cognitive Ownership

最后一个挑战涉及研究人员自身的长期发展。许多人工智能工具使研究的外部产品自动化：摘要、代码、图表、手稿、评论、反驳和幻灯片。然而，研究的认知价值在于形成假设、理解先前的工作、诊断失败、解释结果、构建论点和回应批评。如果人工智能工具过于积极地绕过这些流程，它们可能会提高短期生产力，同时削弱定义科学专业知识的技能。A final challenge concerns the long-term development of researchers themselves. Many AI tools automate the external products of research: summaries, code, plots, manuscripts, reviews, rebuttals, and slides. However, the cognitive value of research lies in forming hypotheses, understanding prior work, diagnosing failures, interpreting results, constructing arguments, and responding to critique. If AI tools bypass these processes too aggressively, they may increase short-term productivity while weakening the skills that define scientific expertise.

这种担忧在写作领域最为明显，人工智能辅助已经被广泛采用，但它适用于整个生命周期。委托文献综合的初级研究员可能无法发展现场判断力；委托实验计划的人可能不知道什么使证据具有决定性；授权反驳的人可能无法学会如何从批评中推理。 Script&Shift 等工具This concern is most visible in Writing, where AI assistance is already widely adopted, but it applies across the lifecycle. A junior researcher who delegates literature synthesis may not develop field judgment; one who delegates experiment planning may not learn what makes evidence decisive; one who delegates rebuttal may not learn how to reason from criticism. Tools such as Script&Shift[186]和草稿标记and DraftMarks[188]提出更好的设计方向：人工智能应该支持源代码转换、流程透明度和反思性修订，而不是取代用户的认知参与。实际原则是人工智能应该处理机械、重复或支架式任务，而人类则保留判断、解释、论证和责任的所有权。suggest a better design direction: AI should support source transformation, process transparency, and reflective revision rather than replacing the user’s cognitive engagement. The practical principle is that AI should handle mechanical, repetitive, or scaffolded tasks, while humans retain ownership of judgment, interpretation, argumentation, and accountability.

7.4.8 迈向可靠的人工智能辅助研究Toward Reliable AI-Assisted Research

总的来说，这些挑战表明人工智能辅助研究的目标发生了转变。近期目标不应是完全自主的科学，即人工智能系统在不受监督的情况下独立生成、验证、发布和促进研究。更可信的目标是可靠的、由人类管理的研究自动化：扩大研究规模和速度，同时保持可追溯性、验证、专家判断和问责制的系统。Taken together, these challenges suggest a shift in the goal of AI-assisted research. The near-term objective should not be fully autonomous science in which AI systems independently generate, validate, publish, and promote research without oversight. A more credible objective is reliable human-governed research automation: systems that expand the scale and speed of research while preserving traceability, verification, expert judgment, and accountability.

未来的进步可能来自于整合四种设计原则的系统。首先，他们应该在整个生命周期中保持出处，将想法、证据、代码、数字、声明、评论、反驳和传播工件联系起来。其次，他们应该尽可能使用执行和检索基础，用可验证的信号取代纯粹的文本自我判断。第三，它们应该在阶段边界处包括人工检查点，因为错误最有可能在这些地方传播。第四，他们应该让人工智能的参与变得透明，以便读者、审稿人和机构能够评估研究成果是如何产生的。这些原则定义了从工件生成系统到值得信赖的研究合作者的路径。Future progress will likely come from systems that integrate four design principles. First, they should maintain provenance across the full lifecycle, linking ideas, evidence, code, figures, claims, reviews, rebuttals, and dissemination artifacts. Second, they should use execution and retrieval grounding wherever possible, replacing purely textual self-judgment with verifiable signals. Third, they should include human checkpoints at phase boundaries, where errors are most likely to propagate. Fourth, they should make AI involvement transparent, so that readers, reviewers, and institutions can assess how a research artifact was produced. These principles define the path from artifact-generating systems toward trustworthy research collaborators.

8 结论Conclusion

这项工作对人工智能辅助学术研究的整个生命周期进行了端到端分析。我们将该领域分为四个认识论阶段：This work presented an end-to-end analysis of AI-assisted academic research across the complete lifecycle. We organized the field into four epistemological phases:创造Creation, 写作Writing, 验证Validation, 和, and传播Dissemination，以及涵盖构思、文献综述、编码和实验、表格和图形、论文写作、同行评审、反驳和修订以及 Paper2X 传播的八个阶段。这个生命周期框架连接了通常孤立研究的工具，并揭示了当前系统在哪里成功、在哪里失败，以及错误如何跨阶段边界传播。, and eight stages spanning ideation, literature review, coding and experiments, tables and figures, paper writing, peer review, rebuttal and revision, and Paper2X dissemination. This lifecycle framing connects tools that are often studied in isolation and exposes where current systems succeed, where they fail, and how errors propagate across stage boundaries.

核心发现是，人工智能系统产生研究成果的能力越来越强，但在验证其科学意义方面仍然不太可靠。在整个生命周期中，看似合理的输出可能会掩盖更深层次的失败：想法在执行后可能会减弱，检索到的证据可能会被歪曲，可执行代码可能会实现错误的算法，流畅的手稿可能缺乏论证深度，评论可能会错过方法论缺陷，反驳可能会承诺未实现的修订，传播工件可能会夸大主张。因此，核心瓶颈不仅仅是生成，而是在整个研究过程中保持新颖性、忠实性、可重复性和问责制。The central finding is that AI systems are increasingly capable of producing research artifacts, but remain less reliable at verifying their scientific meaning. Across the lifecycle, plausible outputs can conceal deeper failures: ideas may weaken after execution, retrieved evidence may be misrepresented, executable code may implement the wrong algorithm, fluent manuscripts may lack argumentative depth, reviews may miss methodological flaws, rebuttals may promise unfulfilled revisions, and dissemination artifacts may overstate claims. The core bottleneck is therefore not generation alone, but maintaining novelty, faithfulness, reproducibility, and accountability across the research process.

最可靠的前进道路是由人类主导的人工智能辅助研究。人工智能应该减少检索、起草、编码、可视化、评论支持和传播中的机械摩擦，而研究人员保留对判断、解释、实验设计、论证和最终责任的所有权。未来的系统应该保持跨工件的来源，尽可能使用检索和执行基础，支持阶段边界的人工检查点，并使人工智能的参与变得透明。如果按照这些原则开发，人工智能可以增强人类的创造力和严谨性；如果没有它们，就有可能扩大看似合理但不可靠的研究成果的生产规模。The most credible path forward is human-governed AI-assisted research. AI should reduce mechanical friction in retrieval, drafting, coding, visualization, review support, and dissemination, while researchers retain ownership over judgment, interpretation, experimental design, argumentation, and final responsibility. Future systems should maintain provenance across artifacts, use retrieval and execution grounding wherever possible, support human checkpoints at phase boundaries, and make AI involvement transparent. If developed with these principles, AI can amplify human creativity and rigor; without them, it risks scaling the production of plausible but unreliable research artifacts.

负责任的使用和限制Responsible Use and Limitations

这项工作的目的是告知负责任地使用人工智能辅助研究工具，而不是支持用完全自动化取代人类科学判断。当前的系统在用于协助检索、起草、编码、可视化、审阅支持和传播时最为可靠，而人类则保留对新颖性、解释、验证、作者身份和问责制的责任。由于该领域发展迅速，本文应被视为通过我们的搜索截止的结构化快照，并且人工智能生成的研究成果应在学术使用之前进行独立验证。This work is intended to inform responsible use of AI-assisted research tools, not to endorse replacing human scientific judgment with full automation. Current systems are most reliable when used to assist retrieval, drafting, coding, visualization, review support, and dissemination, while humans retain responsibility for novelty, interpretation, verification, authorship, and accountability. Because the field evolves rapidly, this paper should be read as a structured snapshot through our search cutoff, and AI-generated research outputs should be independently verified before scholarly use.

Our framework extends this view by also covering scientific visualization, peer validation, rebuttal, and dissemination.

这些比较表明，先前的分类法通常按顺序列出研究任务，同时隐含功能区别和反馈循环。我们的四阶段框架使这些依赖关系变得明确。例如，These comparisons show that prior taxonomies often list research tasks sequentially, while leaving functional distinctions and feedback loops implicit. Our four-phase framework makes these dependencies explicit. For example, (同行评审Peer Review）和) and (反驳与修改Rebuttal & Revision）不要简单地将论文写作作为孤立的下游步骤；他们可以将工作流程重定向回) do not simply follow paper writing as isolated downstream steps; they can redirect the workflow back to对于额外的实验，for additional experiments,对于修订后的数字或表格，以及for revised figures or tables, and用于手稿重组。同样，传播工件for manuscript restructuring. Similarly, dissemination artifacts in可能会暴露原始框架中的含糊之处，需要对主张、解释或视觉证据进行修改。may expose ambiguities in the original framing, requiring revisions to claims, explanations, or visual evidence.

这些跨阶段依赖关系对于真正的研究实践至关重要，对于人工智能辅助的工作流程尤其重要，其中错误可能从生成的想法传播到实验，从实验传播到声明，从声明传播到面向公众的摘要。通过将领域组织成These cross-stage dependencies are central to real research practice and are especially important for AI-assisted workflows, where errors can propagate from generated ideas to experiments, from experiments to claims, and from claims to public-facing summaries. By organizing the field into创造Creation, 写作Writing, 验证Validation, 和, and传播Dissemination，我们的框架不仅强调了现有系统涵盖了哪些阶段，而且还强调了证据、主张、批评和沟通必须保持一致的阶段。, our framework highlights not only which stages are covered by existing systems, but also where evidence, claims, critique, and communication must remain aligned.
